Pset_ActionRequest.definition: Definition from IAI: An action request is a request for an action to fulfill a need.
Pset_ActionRequest.name: Pset_ActionRequest

RequestComments.definition: Comments that may be made on the request.

RequestSourceLabel.definition: A specific name or label that further qualifies the identity of a request source. In the event of an email, this may be the email address.

RequestSourceName.definition: The person making the request, where known.

RequestSourceType.definition: Identifies the predefined types of sources through which a request can be made.

Status.definition:
The status currently assigned to the request where:
Hold = wait to see if further requests are received before deciding on action,
NoAction = no action is required on this request,
Schedule = plan action to take place as part of maintenance or other task planning/scheduling,
Urgent = take action immediately.

Pset_ActorCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: A property set that enables further classification of actors, including the ability to give a number of actors to be designated as a population, the number being specified as a property to be dealt with as a single value rather than having to aggregate a number of instances of IfcActor.
Pset_ActorCommon.name: Pset_ActorCommon

Category.definition: Designation of the category into which the actors in the population belong.

NumberOfActors.definition: The number of actors that are to be dealt with together in the population.

SkillLevel.definition: Skill level exhibited by the actor and which indicates an extent of their capability to perform actions on the artefacts upon which they can act.

Pset_ActuatorTypeCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Actuator type common attributes.
Pset_ActuatorTypeCommon.name: Pset_ActuatorTypeCommon

FailPosition.definition: Specifies the required fail-safe position of the actuator.

ManualOverride.definition: Identifies whether hand-operated operation is provided as an override (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE). Note that this value should be set to FALSE by default in the case of a Hand Operated Actuator.

Pset_ActuatorTypeElectricActuator.definition: Definition from IAI: A device that electrically actuates a control element.
Pset_ActuatorTypeElectricActuator.name: Pset_ActuatorTypeElectricActuator

ElectricActuatorType.definition: Enumeration that identifies electric actuator as defined by its operational principle.

Pset_ActuatorTypeHydraulicActuator.definition: Definition from IAI: A device that hydraulically actuates a control element.
Pset_ActuatorTypeHydraulicActuator.name: Pset_ActuatorTypeHydraulicActuator

InputPressure.definition: Maximum design pressure for the actuator.

Pset_ActuatorTypeLinearActuation.definition:
Definition from IAI: Characteristics of linear actuation of an actuator
History: Replaces Pset_LinearActuator
Pset_ActuatorTypeLinearActuation.name: Pset_ActuatorTypeLinearActuation

Force.definition: Indicates the maximum close-off force for the actuator.

Stroke.definition: Indicates the maximum distance the actuator must traverse.

Pset_ActuatorTypePneumaticActuator.definition: Definition from IAI: A device that pneumatically actuates a control element
Pset_ActuatorTypePneumaticActuator.name: Pset_ActuatorTypePneumaticActuator

InputFlowrate.definition: Maximum input control air flowrate requirement

InputPressure.definition: Maximum input control air pressure requirement

Pset_ActuatorTypeRotationalActuation.definition:
Definition from IAI: Characteristics of rotational actuation of an actuator
History: Replaces Pset_RotationalActuator
Pset_ActuatorTypeRotationalActuation.name: Pset_ActuatorTypeRotationalActuation

RangeAngle.definition: Indicates the maximum rotation the actuator must traverse.

Torque.definition: Indicates the maximum close-off torque for the actuator.

Pset_AirSideSystemInformation.definition: Definition from IAI: Attributes that apply to an air side HVAC system. HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 1.0.
Pset_AirSideSystemInformation.name: Pset_AirSideSystemInformation

AirSideSystemDistributionType.definition: This enumeration defines the basic types of air side systems (e.g., SingleDuct, DualDuct, Multizone, etc.)

AirSideSystemType.definition: This enumeration specifies the basic types of possible air side systems (e.g., Constant Volume, Variable Volume, etc.)

AirflowSensible.definition: The air flowrate required to satisfy the sensible peak loads.

CoolingTemperatureDelta.definition: Cooling temperature difference for calculating space air flow rates

Description.definition: The description of the air side system.

EnergyGainSensible.definition: The sum of total energy gains for the spaces served by the system during the peak cooling conditions, plus any system-level sensible energy gains.

EnergyGainTotal.definition: The total amount of energy gains for the spaces served by the system during the peak cooling conditions, plus any system-level total energy gains.

EnergyLoss.definition: The sum of energy losses for the spaces served by the system during the peak heating conditions.

FanPower.definition: Fan motor loads contributing to the cooling load.

HeatingTemperatureDelta.definition: Heating temperature difference for calculating space air flow rates

Name.definition: The name of the air side system

TotalAirflow.definition: The total design supply air flowrate required for the system for either heating or cooling conditions, whichever is greater.

Pset_AirTerminalBoxPHistory.definition: Definition from IAI: Air terminal box performance history attributes.
Pset_AirTerminalBoxPHistory.name: Pset_AirTerminalBoxPHistory

AirflowCurve.definition: Air flowrate versus damper position relationship;airflow = f ( valve position).

DamperPosition.definition: Control damper position, ranging from 0 to 1.

Pset_AirTerminalBoxTypeCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Air terminal box type common attributes.
Pset_AirTerminalBoxTypeCommon.name: Pset_AirTerminalBoxTypeCommon

AirPressureRange.definition: Allowable air static pressure range at the entrance of the air terminal box.

AirflowRateRange.definition: Range of airflow that can be delivered.

ArrangementType.definition:
Terminal box arrangement.
SingleDuct: Terminal box receives warm or cold air from a single air supply duct.
DualDuct: Terminal box receives warm and cold air from separate air supply ducts.

HasFan.definition: Terminal box has a fan inside (fan powered box).

HasReturnAir.definition: Terminal box has return air mixed with supply air from duct work.

HasSoundAttenuator.definition: Terminal box has a sound attenuator.

HousingThickness.definition: Air terminal box housing material thickness.

Material.definition: The primary material used to construct the air terminal box.

OperationTemperatureRange.definition: Allowable operational range of the ambient air temperature.

ReturnAirFractionRange.definition: Allowable return air fraction range as a fraction of discharge airflow.

Weight.definition: Weight of the air terminal box.

Pset_AirTerminalPHistory.definition: Definition from IAI: Air terminal performance history common attributes.
Pset_AirTerminalPHistory.name: Pset_AirTerminalPHistory

CenterlineAirVelocity.definition: Centerline air velocity versus distance from the diffuser and temperature differential; a function of distance from diffuser and temperature difference between supply air and room air.

InductionRatio.definition: Induction ratio versus distance from the diffuser and its discharge direction; induction ratio (or entrainment ratio) is the ratio of the volumetric flow rate in the jet to the volumetric flow rate at the air terminal

PressureDrop.definition: Drop in total pressure between inlet and outlet at nominal air-flow rate.

SupplyAirTemperatureCooling.definition: Supply air temperature in cooling mode

SupplyAirTemperatureHeating.definition: Supply air temperature in heating mode

Pset_AirTerminalTypeCommon.definition:
Definition from IAI: Air terminal type common attributes.
SoundLevel attribute deleted in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum: Use IfcSoundProperties instead.
Pset_AirTerminalTypeCommon.name: Pset_AirTerminalTypeCommon

AirDiffusionPerformanceIndex.definition: The Air Diffusion Performance Index (ADPI) is used for cooling mode conditions. If several measurements of air velocity and air temperature are made throughout the occupied zone of a space, the ADPI is the percentage of locations where measurements were taken that meet the specifications for effective draft temperature and air velocity.

AirFlowrateRange.definition: Air flowrate range within which the air terminal is designed to operate.

AirFlowrateVersusFlowControlElement.definition: Air flowrate versus flow control element position at nominal pressure drop.

CoreSetHorizontal.definition: Degree of horizontal (in the X-axis of the LocalPlacement) blade set from the centerline.

CoreSetVertical.definition: Degree of vertical (in the Y-axis of the LocalPlacement) blade set from the centerline.

CoreType.definition: Identifies the way the core of the AirTerminal is constructed.

DischargeDirection.definition:
Discharge direction of the air terminal.
Parallel: discharges parallel to mounting surface designed so that flow attaches to the surface.
Perpendicular:  discharges away from mounting surface.
Adjustable: both parallel and perpendicular discharge.

EffectiveArea.definition: Effective discharge area of the air terminal.

FinishColor.definition: The finish color for the air terminal.

FinishType.definition: The type of finish for the air terminal.

FlowControlType.definition: Type of flow control element that may be included as a part of the construction of the air terminal.

HasIntegralControl.definition: If TRUE, a self powered temperature control is included in the AirTerminal.

HasSoundAttenuator.definition: If TRUE, the air terminal has sound attenuation.

HasThermalInsulation.definition: If TRUE, the air terminal has thermal insulation.

Material.definition: The primary material used to construct the air terminal.

MountingType.definition:
The way the air terminal is mounted to the ceiling, wall, etc.
Surface type is mounted to the surface of something (e.g., wall, duct, etc.).
Flat flush type is mounted flat and flush with a surface.
Lay-in type is mounted in a lay-in type ceiling (e.g., a dropped ceiling grid).

NeckArea.definition: Neck area of the air terminal.

Shape.definition: Shape of the air terminal. Slot is typically a long narrow supply device with an aspect ratio generally greater than 10 to 1.

TemperatureRange.definition: Temperature range within which the air terminal is designed to operate.

ThrowLength.definition: The horizontal or vertical axial distance an airstream travels after leaving an AirTerminal before the maximum stream velocity is reduced to a specified terminal velocity under isothermal conditions at the upper value of the AirFlowrateRange.

Pset_AirTerminalTypeRectangular.definition: Definition from IAI: Rectangular air terminal type attributes.
Pset_AirTerminalTypeRectangular.name: Pset_AirTerminalTypeRectangular

FaceType.definition: Identifies how the terminal face of an AirTerminal is constructed.

Pset_AirTerminalTypeRound.definition: Definition from IAI: Round air terminal type attributes.
Pset_AirTerminalTypeRound.name: Pset_AirTerminalTypeRound

FaceType.definition: Identifies how the terminal face of an AirTerminal is constructed.

Pset_AirTerminalTypeSlot.definition: Definition from IAI: Slot air terminal type attributes.
Pset_AirTerminalTypeSlot.name: Pset_AirTerminalTypeSlot

Pset_AirTerminalTypeSquare.definition: Definition from IAI: Square air terminal type attributes.
Pset_AirTerminalTypeSquare.name: Pset_AirTerminalTypeSquare

FaceType.definition: Identifies how the terminal face of an AirTerminal is constructed.

Pset_AirToAirHeatRecoveryPHist.definition: Definition from IAI: Air to Air Heat Recovery performance history common attributes.
Pset_AirToAirHeatRecoveryPHist.name: Pset_AirToAirHeatRecoveryPHist

AirPressureDropCurves.definition: Air pressure drop as function of air flow rate

DefrostTemperatureEffectiveness.definition: Temperature heat transfer effectiveness when defrosting is active.

HumidityEffectiveness.definition: Humidity heat transfer effectiveness: The ratio of primary airflow absolute humidity changes to maximum possible absolute humidity changes.

SensibleEffectiveness.definition: Sensible heat transfer effectiveness, where effectiveness is defined as the ratio of heat transfer to maximum possible heat transfer.

SensibleEffectivenessTable.definition: Sensible heat transfer effectiveness curve as a function of the primary and secondary air flow rate.

TemperatureEffectiveness.definition: Temperature heat transfer effectiveness: The ratio of primary airflow temperature changes to maximum possible temperature changes.

TotalEffectiveness.definition: Total heat transfer effectiveness: The ratio of heat transfer to the maximum possible heat transfer.

TotalEffectivenessTable.definition: Total heat transfer effectiveness curve as a function of the primary and secondary air flow rate.

Pset_AirToAirHeatRecoveryTypeCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Air to Air Heat Recovery type common attributes.
Pset_AirToAirHeatRecoveryTypeCommon.name: Pset_AirToAirHeatRecoveryTypeCommon

HasDefrost.definition: has the heat exchanger has defrost function or not

HeatTransferTypeEnum.definition: Type of heat transfer between the two air streams.

MediaMaterial.definition: The primary media material used for heat transfer.

OperationalTemperatureRange.definition: Allowable operation ambient air temperature range

PrimaryAirflowRateRange.definition: possible range of primary airflow that can be delivered

SecondaryAirflowRateRange.definition: possible range of secondary airflow that can be delivered

Pset_AnalogInput.definition: Definition from IAI: Defines the characteristics of an analog input.
Pset_AnalogInput.name: Pset_AnalogInput

Deadband.definition: The deadband value for the analog input.

EventEnable.definition: Enumeration that defines the type of event enabling

HighLimit.definition: The high limit value for the analog input.

HighLimitEnable.definition: Is high limit validation enabled (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

LowLimit.definition: The low limit value for the analog input.

LowLimitEnable.definition: Is low limit validation enabled (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

NotifyType.definition: Enumeration that defines the notification type

Pset_AnalogOutput.definition: Definition from IAI: Defines the characteristics of an analog output.
Pset_AnalogOutput.name: Pset_AnalogOutput

Deadband.definition: The deadband value for the analog output.

EventEnable.definition: Enumeration that defines the type of event enabling

HighLimit.definition: The high limit value for the analog output.

HighLimitEnable.definition: Is high limit validation enabled (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

LowLimit.definition: The low limit value for the analog output.

LowLimitEnable.definition: Is low limit validation enabled (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

NotifyType.definition: Enumeration that defines the notification type

Pset_Asset.definition: Definition from IAI: An asset is a uniquely identifiable element which has a financial value and against which maintenance actions are recorded.
Pset_Asset.name: Pset_Asset

AssetAccountingType.definition: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

AssetInsuranceType.definition: Identifies the predefined types of insurance rating from which the type required may be set.

AssetTaxType.definition: Identifies the predefined types of taxation group from which the type required may be set.

Pset_BeamCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcBeam.
Pset_BeamCommon.name: Pset_BeamCommon

FireRating.definition:
Fire rating for this object.
It is given according to the national fire safety classification.

IsExternal.definition: Indication whether the element is designed for use in the exterior (TRUE) or not (FALSE). If (TRUE) it is an external element and faces the outside of the building.

LoadBearing.definition: Indicates whether the object is intended to carry loads (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

Reference.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1')

Slope.definition:
Slope angle - relative to horizontal (0.0 degrees).
The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

Span.definition:
Clear span for this object.
The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

Pset_BinaryInput.definition: Definition from IAI: Defines the characteristics of a binary input.
Pset_BinaryInput.name: Pset_BinaryInput

AckedTransitions.definition: Enumeration that defines the type of transition acknowledgement

ActiveText.definition: String value to be displayed in an active, on, or running state

EventEnable.definition: Enumeration that defines the type of event enabling

FeedbackValue.definition: Enumeration defining the feedback value from the control system element

InactiveText.definition: String value to be displayed in an inactive, off, or idle state

Pset_BinaryOutput.definition: Definition from IAI: Defines the characteristics of a binary output.
Pset_BinaryOutput.name: Pset_BinaryOutput

AckedTransitions.definition: Enumeration that defines the type of transition acknowledgement

ActiveText.definition: String value to be displayed in an active, on, or running state

AlarmValue.definition: Enumeration defining the operating state of the control system element

EventEnable.definition: Enumeration that defines the type of event enabling

InactiveText.definition: String value to be displayed in an inactive, off, or idle state

Pset_BoilerPHistory.definition:
Definition from IAI: Boiler performance history common attributes.
WaterQuality attribute deleted in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum: Use IfcWaterProperties instead. CombustionProductsMaximulLoad and CombustionProductsPartialLoad attributes deleted in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum: Use IfcProductsOfCombustionProperties instead.
Pset_BoilerPHistory.name: Pset_BoilerPHistory

AuxiliaryEnergyConsumption.definition: Boiler secondary energy source consumption (i.e., the electricity consumed by electrical devices such as fans and pumps).

OperationalEfficiency.definition: Operational efficiency: boiler output divided by total energy input (electrical and fuel)

PartLoadRatio.definition: Ratio of the real to the nominal capacity.

PrimaryEnergyConsumption.definition: Boiler primary energy source consumption (i.e., the fuel consumed for changing the thermodynamic state of the fluid).

Pset_BoilerTypeCommon.definition:
Definition from IAI: Boiler type common attributes.
SoundLevel attribute deleted in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum: Use IfcSoundProperties instead. PrimaryEnergySource and AuxiliaryEnergySource attributes deleted in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum: Use IfcEnergyProperties, IfcFuelProperties, etc. instead.
Pset_BoilerTypeCommon.name: Pset_BoilerTypeCommon

HeatOutput.definition: Total nominal heat output as listed by the Boiler manufacturer. For water boilers, it is a function of inlet versus outlet temperature. For steam boilers, it is a function of inlet temperature versus steam pressure.

HeatTransferSurfaceArea.definition: Total heat transfer area of the vessel.

IsWaterStorageHeater.definition: This is used to identify if the boiler has storage capacity (TRUE). If FALSE, then there is no storage capacity built into the boiler, such as an instantaneous hot water heater.

Material.definition: The primary material used to construct the boiler's heat transfer vessel.

NominalEfficiency.definition: The nominal efficiency of the boiler as defined by the manufacturer. For water boilers, a function of inlet versus outlet temperature. For steam boilers, a function of inlet temperature versus steam pressure.

NominalEnergyConsumption.definition: Nominal fuel consumption rate required to produce the total boiler heat output.

OperatingMode.definition: Identifies the operating mode of the boiler.

OutletTemperatureRange.definition: Allowable outlet temperature of either the water or the steam.

PartialLoadEfficiencyCurves.definition: Boiler efficiency as a function of the partial load factor; E = f (partialLaodfactor).

PressureRating.definition: Nominal pressure rating of the boiler as rated by ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code Section IV, Rules for Construction of Heating Boilers, and Section I, Rules for Construction of Power Boilers

Pset_BoilerTypeSteam.definition: Definition from IAI: Steam boiler type common attributes.
Pset_BoilerTypeSteam.name: Pset_BoilerTypeSteam

Pset_BuildingCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcBuilding. Please note that several building attributes are handled directly at the IfcBuilding instance, the building number (or short name) by IfcBuilding.Name, the building name (or long name) by IfcBuilding.LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcBuilding.Description. Actual building quantities, like building perimeter, building area and building volume are provided by IfcElementQuantities, and the building classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference.
Pset_BuildingCommon.name: Pset_BuildingCommon

AncillaryFireUse.definition: Ancillary fire use for the building which is assigned from the fire use classification table as given by the relevant national building code.

BuildingID.definition: A unique identifier assigned to a building. A temporary identifier is initially assigned at the time of making a planning application. This temporary identifier is changed to a permanent identifier when the building is registered into a statutory buildings and properties database.

GrossPlannedArea.definition: Total planned area for the building  Used for programming the building.

IsLandmarked.definition: This builing is listed as a historic building (TRUE), or not (FALSE), or unknown.

IsPermanentID.definition: Indicates whether the identity assigned to a building is permanent (= TRUE) or temporary (=FALSE)

MainFireUse.definition: Main fire use for the building which is assigned from the fire use classification table as given by the relevant national building code.

NumberOfStoreys.definition: Captures the number of storeys within a building for those cases where the IfcBuildingStorey entity is not used. Note that if IfcBuilingStorey is asserted and the number of storeys in a building can be determined from it, then this approach should be used in preference to setting a property for the number of storeys.

OccupancyType.definition:
Occupancy type for this object.
It is defined according to the presiding national building code.

SprinklerProtection.definition: Indication whether this object is sprinkler protected (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

SprinklerProtectionAutomatic.definition:
Indication whether this object has an automatic sprinkler protection (TRUE) or not (FALSE).
It should only be given, if the property "SprinklerProtection" is set to TRUE.

YearOfConstruction.definition: Year of construction of this building, including expected year of completion.

Pset_BuildingElementProxyCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcBuildingElementProxy.
Pset_BuildingElementProxyCommon.name: Pset_BuildingElementProxyCommon

Reference.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1')

Pset_BuildingStoreyCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcBuildingStorey. Please note that several building attributes are handled directly at the IfcBuildingStorey instance, the building storey number (or short name) by IfcBuildingStorey.Name, the building storey name (or long name) by IfcBuildingStorey.LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcBuildingStorey.Description. Actual building storey quantities, like building storey perimeter, building storey area and building storey volume are provided by IfcElementQuantities, and the building storey classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference.
Pset_BuildingStoreyCommon.name: Pset_BuildingStoreyCommon

AboveGround.definition: Indication whether this building storey is fully above ground (TRUE), or below ground (FALSE), or partially above and below ground (UNKNOWN) - as in sloped terrain.

EntranceLevel.definition: Indication whether this building storey is an entrance level to the building (TRUE), or (FALSE) if otherwise.

GrossAreaPlanned.definition: Total planned area for the building storey. Used for programming the building storey.

NetAreaPlanned.definition: Total planned net area for the building storey. Used for programming the building storey.

SprinklerProtection.definition: Indication whether this object is sprinkler protected (true) or not (false).

SprinklerProtectionAutomatic.definition:
Indication whether this object has an automatic sprinkler protection (true) or not (false).
It should only be given, if the property "SprinklerProtection" is set to TRUE.

Pset_BuildingUse.definition: Definition from IAI: Provides information on on the real estate context of the building of interest both current and anticipated.
Pset_BuildingUse.name: Pset_BuildingUse

MarketCategory.definition: Category of use e.g. residential, commercial, recreation etc.

MarketSubCategoriesAvailableFuture.definition: A list of the sub categories of property that are expected to be available in the future expressed in terms of IfcLabel

MarketSubCategoriesAvailableNow.definition: A list of the sub categories of property that are currently available expressed in terms of IfcLabel

MarketSubCategory.definition: Subset of category of use e.g. multi-family, 2 bedroom, low rise

NarrativeText.definition: Added information relating to the adjacent building use that is not appropriate to the general descriptive text associated with an entity through the inherited IfcRoot.Description

PlanningControlStatus.definition: Label of zoning category or class, or planning control category for the site or facility.

RentalRatesInCategoryFuture.definition: Range of the cost rates for property expected to be available in the future in the required category.

RentalRatesInCategoryNow.definition: Range of the cost rates for property currently available in the required category.

TenureModesAvailableFuture.definition: A list of the tenure modes that are expected to be available in the future expressed in terms of IfcLabel

TenureModesAvailableNow.definition: A list of the tenure modes that are currently available expressed in terms of IfcLabel

VacancyRateInCategoryFuture.definition: Percentage of vacancy found in the particular category expected in the future

VacancyRateInCategoryNow.definition: Percentage of vacancy found in the particular category currently

Pset_BuildingUseAdjacent.definition: Definition from IAI: Provides information on adjacent buildings and their uses to enable their impact on the building of interest to be determined. Note that for each instance of the property set used, where there is an existence of risk, there will be an instance of the property set Pset_Risk (q.v)
Pset_BuildingUseAdjacent.name: Pset_BuildingUseAdjacent

MarketCategory.definition: Category of use e.g. residential, commercial, recreation etc.

MarketSubCategory.definition: Subset of category of use e.g. multi-family, 2 bedroom, low rise

NarrativeText.definition: Added information relating to the adjacent building use that is not appropriate to the general descriptive text associated with an entity through the inherited IfcRoot.Description

PlanningControlStatus.definition: Label of zoning category or class, or planning control category for the site or facility.

Pset_BuildingWaterStorage.definition:
The basic set of properties that are used for determining the water requirements for a building.
Typically, this property set is expected to be used in conjunction with IfcBuilding.
Pset_BuildingWaterStorage.name: Pset_BuildingWaterStorage

OneDayCoolingTowerMakeupWater.definition: The volume of water that needs to be stored to supply make up water to the cooling towers in a building for one day in the event of water supply failure.

OneDayEssentialWater.definition: The volume of water that needs to be stored to supply water to the building for uninterrupted water supply to essential areas for one day in the event of water supply failure. An essential area is considered to be a part of a building carrying out a critical function and that is unable to operate in the intended manner without a water supply.

OneDayPotableWater.definition: The volume of water that needs to be stored to supply water to the building for human use for one day in the event of water supply failure.

OneDayProcessOrProductionWater.definition: The volume of water that needs to be stored to supply water for process or production requirements in a building for one day in the event of water supply failure.

WaterStorageRatePerPerson.definition: The volume of domestic water that needs to be stored per person.

Pset_CableCarrierSegmentTypeCableLadderS.definition: Definition from IAI: An open carrier segment on which cables are carried on a ladder structure.
Pset_CableCarrierSegmentTypeCableLadderS.name: Pset_CableCarrierSegmentTypeCableLadderSegment

LadderConfiguration.definition: Description of the configuration of the ladder structure used.

NominalHeight.definition: The nominal height of the segment

NominalLength.definition: The nominal length of the segment.

NominalWidth.definition: The nominal width of the segment

Pset_CableCarrierSegmentTypeCableTraySeg.definition: Definition from IAI: An (typically) open carrier segment onto which cables are laid.
Pset_CableCarrierSegmentTypeCableTraySeg.name: Pset_CableCarrierSegmentTypeCableTraySegment

HasCover.definition: Indication of whether the cable tray has a cover (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE). By default, this value should be set to FALSE.

NominalHeight.definition: The nominal height of the segment

NominalLength.definition: The nominal length of the segment.

NominalWidth.definition: The nominal width of the segment

Pset_CableCarrierSegmentTypeCableTrunkin.definition: Definition from IAI: An enclosed carrier segment with one or more compartments into which cables are placed.
Pset_CableCarrierSegmentTypeCableTrunkin.name: Pset_CableCarrierSegmentTypeCableTrunkingSegment

NominalHeight.definition: The nominal height of the segment

NominalLength.definition: The nominal length of the segment.

NominalWidth.definition: The nominal width of the segment

NumberOfCompartments.definition: The number of separate internal compartments within the trunking

Pset_CableCarrierSegmentTypeConduitSegme.definition: Definition from IAI: An enclosed tubular carrier segment through which cables are pulled.
Pset_CableCarrierSegmentTypeConduitSegme.name: Pset_CableCarrierSegmentTypeConduitSegment

ConduitShapeType.definition: The shape of the conduit segment

IsRigid.definition: Indication of whether the conduit is rigid (= TRUE) or flexible (= FALSE)

NominalHeight.definition: The nominal height of the segment

NominalLength.definition: The nominal length of the segment.

NominalWidth.definition: The nominal width of the segment

Pset_CableSegmentTypeCableSegment.definition: Definition from IAI: Electrical cable with a specific purpose to lead electric current within a circuit or any other electric construction. Includes all types of electric cables, mainly several electrical segments wrapped together, e.g. cable, tube, busbar. Note that the number of conductors within a cable is determined by an aggregation mechanism that aggregates the conductors within the cable.
Pset_CableSegmentTypeCableSegment.name: Pset_CableSegmentTypeCableSegment

CableInsulationMaterial.definition: The material from which the insulation is constructed. Such as PVC, PEX, EPR,...

CrossSectionalArea.definition: Cross section area of the cable

MaxOperatingTemperature.definition: Maximum operating temperature for the cable.

NominalHeight.definition: The nominal height of a cable, busbar or tube or, in the case of a circular cross section, the height is not asserted. Note that this value may be used for larger sized cables whose dimensions are explicitly given.

NominalLength.definition: The nominal length of a cable, busbar or tube.

NominalWidthOrDiameter.definition: The nominal width of a cable, busbar or tube or, in the case of a circular cross section, the diameter. Note that this value may be used for larger sized cables whose dimensions are explicitly given.

NormalOperatingTemperature.definition: Normal operating temperature for the cable, busbar.

Pset_CableSegmentTypeConductorSegment.definition: Definition from IAI: An electrical conductor is a single linear element with the specific purpose to lead electric current. The core of one lead is normally single wired or multiwired which are intertwined.
Pset_CableSegmentTypeConductorSegment.name: Pset_CableSegmentTypeConductorSegment

ConductorMaterial.definition: Type of material from which the conductor is constructed. Such as Aluminium or Copper

ConductorSheathMaterial.definition: The material from which the sheath or insulation is constructed. Such as EPR, Copper, MICC, PVC, PEX, Rubber, XPLE, XPLE_LS. Note that materials used should be agreed between exchange participants before use.

CrossSectionalArea.definition: Cross section area of the phase(s) lead(s)

ElectricalConductorFunction.definition: Type of function for which the conductor is intended.

IsFireResistant.definition: Indication of whether the sheath is fire resistant (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

MaximumOperatingTemperature.definition: The maximum temperature at which the sheath retains its integrity.

NominalLength.definition: The nominal length of a conductor.

PhaseReference.definition: The phase identification used when the function of the conductor is a phase. In general, it is recommended that IEC recommendations for phase identification are used (L1, L2 etc.). Pset_ChillerTypeCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Chiller type common attributes.
Pset_ChillerTypeCommon.name: Pset_ChillerTypeCommon

NominalEfficiency.definition: Nominal chiller efficiency under nominal conditions.

NominalHeatRejectionRate.definition: Sum of the refrigeration effect and the heat equivalent of the power input to the compressor.

CoilConnectionDirection.definition: Coil connection direction (facing into the air stream).

CoilCoolant.definition: The fluid used for heating or cooling used by the hydronic coil.

CoilFaceArea.definition: Coil face area in the direction against air the flow.

CoilFluidArrangement.definition:

CrossCounterFlow: Air and water flow enter in different directions.
CrossFlow: Air and water flow are perpendicular.
CrossParallelFlow: Air and water flow enter in same directions

Fluid.definition: The properties of the hydronic fluid used for heat transfer within the coil tubes.

HeatExchangeSurfaceArea.definition: Heat exchange surface area associated with U-value.

PrimarySurfaceArea.definition: Primary heat transfer surface area of the tubes and headers.

SecondarySurfaceArea.definition: Secondary heat transfer surface area created by fins.

SensibleHeatRatio.definition: Air-side sensible heat ratio, or fraction of sensible heat transfer to the total heat transfer.

TotalUACurves.definition: Total UA curves, UA - air and water velocities, UA = [(C1 * AirFlowRate^0.8)^-1 + (C2 * WaterFlowRate^0.8)^-1]^-1.

WaterPressureDropCurve.definition: Water pressure drop curve, pressure drop – flow rate curve, WaterPressureDrop = f(WaterflowRate).

WetCoilFraction.definition: Fraction of coil surface area that is wet (0-1).

Pset_ColumnCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcColumn.
Pset_ColumnCommon.name: Pset_ColumnCommon

FireRating.definition:

IsExternal.definition: Indication whether the element is designed for use in the exterior (TRUE) or not (FALSE). If (TRUE) it is an external element and faces the outside of the building.

LoadBearing.definition: Indicates whether the object is intended to carry loads (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

Reference.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1')

Slope.definition:
Slope angle - relative to horizontal (0.0 degrees).

Pset_CompressorPHistory.definition: Definition from IAI: Compressor performance history attributes.
Pset_CompressorPHistory.name: Pset_CompressorPHistory

CompressionEfficiency.definition: Ratio of the work required for isentropic compression of the gas to the work delivered to the gas within the compression volume (as obtained by measurement).

CompressorCapacity.definition: The product of the  ideal capacity and the overall volumetric efficiency of the compressor.

CompressorTotalEfficiency.definition: Ratio of the thermal cooling capacity to electrical input.

FullLoadRatioCurve.definition: Ratio of actual power to full load power as a quadratic function of part load, at certain condensing and evaporating temperature, FracFullLoadPower = f ( PartLoadRatio).

InputPower.definition: Input power to the compressor motor.

IsentropicEfficiency.definition: Ratio of the work required for isentropic compression of the gas to work input to the compressor shaft.

MechanicalEfficiency.definition: Ratio of the work (as measured) delivered to the gas to the work input to the compressor shaft.

ShaftPower.definition: The actual shaft power input to the compressor.

VolumetricEfficiency.definition: Ratio of the actual volume of gas entering the compressor to the theoretical displacement of the compressor.

Pset_CompressorTypeCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Compressor type common attributes.
Pset_CompressorTypeCommon.name: Pset_CompressorTypeCommon

HasHotGasBypass.definition: Whether or not hot gas bypass is provided for the compressor. TRUE = Yes, FALSE = No.

IdealShaftPower.definition: Compressor shaft power under ideal conditions.

MaximumPartLoadRatio.definition: Maximum part load ratio as a fraction of nominal capacity.

MinimumPartLoadRatio.definition: Minimum part load ratio as a fraction of nominal capacity.

PowerSource.definition: Type of power driving the compressor

RefrigerantClass.definition:
Refrigerant class used by the compressor.
CFC: Chlorofluorocarbons.
HCFC: Hydrochlorofluorocarbons.
HFC: Hydrofluorocarbons.

Pset_ConcreteElementGeneral.definition: Definition from IAI: General properties common to different types of concrete elements. The Pset can be used by a number of subtypes of IfcBuildingElement.
Pset_ConcreteElementGeneral.name: Pset_ConcreteElementGeneral

ConcreteCoverAtLinks.definition: The protective concrete cover at the reinforcement links according to local building regulations.

ConcreteCoverAtMainBars.definition: The protective concrete cover at the main reinforcing bars according to local building regulations.

ConstructionToleranceClass.definition: Classification designation of the on-site construction tolerances according to local standards.

ConstructionType.definition: Designator for whether the concrete element is constructed on site or prefabricated. Allowed values are: 'Insitu' vs 'Precast'

DimensionalAccuracyClass.definition: Classification designation of the dimensional accuracy requirement according to local standards.

EnvironmentalClass.definition: The environmental class for the concrete structure (e.g. 'Y1')

FireRating.definition: Fire rating given according to the national fire safety classification

LifeCycleEnvironmentalLoad.definition: Description of the life-cycle environmental load

ServiceLife.definition: Expected service life (usually measured in years)

StructuralClass.definition: The structural class defined for the concrete structure (e.g. '1').

Pset_ConcreteElementQuantityGeneral.definition: Definition from IAI: Bill-of-Quantity properties common to different types of precast concrete elements. The Pset is used to express the total bulk quantities per element. The quantities may include the concrete, reinforcement, and different kinds of accessories. The Pset can be used by a number of subtypes of IfcBuildingElement. Note: Bulk quantities for parts used for surface finish, tiles, bricks, etc. are included as area quantities in Pset_ConcreteElementSurfaceFinishQuantityGeneral.
Pset_ConcreteElementQuantityGeneral.name: Pset_ConcreteElementQuantityGeneral

TotalAccessoryQuantity.definition: The total bulk quantity of accessories per type of accessory for the precast concrete element. The quantity may be expressed as number of items or mass measure in kg or both. Note: several complex properties of this type, one for each accessory type, may be attached to the Pset.

AccessoryDescription.definition: Short textual description of the accessory.

AccessoryGroupCode.definition: Classification code of the accessory type group  according to local standards.

AccessoryMaterial.definition: Material designation according to local classification standards.

AccessoryMaterialSpecificationReference.definition: Reference to the accessory material standard specification.

AccessoryQuantityByNumberOfItems.definition: The total quantity of accessories of the specified accessory type expressed as number of items.

AccessoryQuantityByWeight.definition: The total quantity of accessories of the specified accessory type expressed as mass measure in kg.

AccessorySize.definition: Size designation according to local classification standards or manufacturer practices.

AccessoryType.definition: Type designation of the accessory according to local standards.

AccessoryTypeSpecificationReference.definition: Reference to the accessory standard specification.

TotalConcreteQuantity.definition: The total bulk quantity of concrete used for the precast concrete element expressed as the volume of concrete in cubic meter (m3).

TotalRebarQuantity.definition: The total bulk quantity of rebar per size used for the precast concrete element expressed as the mass measure of rebar in kg. Note: several complex properties of this type, one for each rebar size, may be attached to the Pset.

RebarDiameter.definition: The rebar size (nominal diameter) for which the total quantity is specified.

RebarQuantity.definition: The total quantity of rebar for the specified bar size expressed as the mass measure of rebar in kg.

RebarSteelGrade.definition: The rebar steel grade (e.g. 'A500HW') for which the total quantity is specified.

RebarSteelGradeSpecificationReference.definition: Reference to steel grade standard specification.

Pset_ConcreteElementSurfaceFinishQuantit.definition: Definition from IAI: Surface finish related properties common to different types of concrete elements. The Pset can be used by a number of subtypes of IfcBuildingElement, like IfcBeam, IfcColumn, IfcWall, etc. If a precast concrete element is a sandwich wall panel each structural layer or shell represented by an IfcBuildingElementPart may be attached to a separate Pset.The surface finishes are expressed as area quantities only for each surface finish type. The exact details (location, area shape, overlaps, tile joints, patterns, etc.) of the surface finishes are expressed in external documents using the IfcDocumentReference mechanism. Each of the defined properties are instantiated as needed, and multiple instantiations of the same property for each different surface classification are possible.
Pset_ConcreteElementSurfaceFinishQuantit.name: Pset_ConcreteElementSurfaceFinishQuantityGeneral

ExternalSurface.definition: External surface area quantity.Several complex properties of this type may be attached to this Pset, one for each external subsurface with different properties

ExternalSurfaceArea.definition: The external surface area quantity for which the particular surface finish is defined. Usually expressed in square meter (m2).

ExternalSurfaceClass.definition: Class designation for the surface. This usually depends on what kind of surface type is used and how the classification is expressed in local standards.

ExternalSurfaceType.definition: Type designation for the surface. Typical surface treatments include: hewing, acid treatment, brushing, sand blasting, grinding, sanding, painting, cleansing, parging, roller application, and different kinds of tile cladding, e.g. bricks, brick tiles, clinker and mosaic tiles, etc.

FormSurface.definition: Formwork surface area quantity. Several complex properties of this type may be attached to this Pset, one for each formwork subsurface with different properties.

FormSurfaceArea.definition: The form surface area quantity for which the particular form surface finish and possibly texture type is defined. Usually expressed in square meter (m2).

FormSurfaceClass.definition: Classification designation for the formwork surface according to local standards, e.g. E, 1, 2, or 3.

FormSurfaceTextureDescription.definition: Textual description of the form surface texture pattern. Used only if the form work includes sub-areas with textures.

SurfaceDescriptionDocReference.definition: Reference to an external document describing the details of the surface of the concrete element, i.e. a drawing or textual document file.

CompressorCondenserPressureDrop.definition: Pressure drop between condenser inlet and compressor outlet.

ExteriorHeatTransferCoefficient.definition: Exterior heat transfer coefficient associated with exterior surface area.

HeatRejectionRate.definition: Sum of the refrigeration effect and the heat equivalent of the power input to the compressor.

InteriorHeatTransferCoefficient.definition: Interior heat transfer coefficient associated with interior surface area.

LogarithmicMeanTemperatureDifference.definition: Logarithmic mean temperature difference between refrigerant and water or air.

RefrigerantFoulingResistance.definition: Fouling resistance on the refrigerant side.

UAcurves.definition: UV = f (VExterior, VInterior), UV as a function of interior and exterior fluid flow velocity at the entrance.

ExternalSurfaceArea.definition: External surface area (both primary and secondary area).

NominalHeatTransferArea.definition: Nominal heat transfer surface area associated with nominal overall heat transfer coefficient.

NominalHeatTransferCoefficient.definition: Nominal overall heat transfer coefficient associated with nominal heat transfer area.

RefrigerantClass.definition:

CFC: Chlorofluorocarbons.
HCFC: Hydrochlorofluorocarbons.
HFC: Hydrofluorocarbons.

AirPressureDropCurves.definition: Air pressure drop as function of air flow rate

Throw.definition: Distance cooled beam throws the air

AirFlowConfiguration.definition: Air flow configuration type of cooled beam

AirflowRateRange.definition: Possible range of airflow that can be delivered

SoundLevel and SoundAttenuation attributes deleted in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum: Use IfcSoundProperties instead.
Pset_CooledBeamTypeCommon.name: Pset_CooledBeamTypeCommon

IsFreeHanging.definition: Is it free hanging type (not mounted in a false ceiling)?

WaterPressureRange.definition: Allowable water circuit working pressure range.

Performance.definition: Water temperature change as a function of wet-bulb temperature, water entering temperature, water flow rate, air flow rate, Tdiff = f ( Twet-bulb, Twater,in, mwater, mair).

SumpHeaterPower.definition: Electrical heat power of sump heater.

UACurve.definition: UA value as a  function of fan speed at certain water flow rate, UA = f ( fan speed).

WaterRequirement attribute unit type modified in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum.

CapacityControl.definition:
FanCycling: Fan is cycled on and off to control duty.
TwoSpeedFan: Fan is switched between low and high speed to control duty.

BypassValveControl: Bypass valve modulates the water flow to control duty.

CrossFlow: Air and water flow are perpendicular.

LiftElevationDifference.definition: Elevation difference between cooling tower sump and the top of the tower.

NumberOfCells.definition: Number of cells in one cooling tower unit.

OperationTemperatureRange.definition: Allowable operation ambient air temperature range

SprayType.definition:

SplashTypeFill: water cascades over successive rows of splash bars.
FilmTypeFill: water flows in a thin layer over closely spaced sheets.

Pset_DoorCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcDoor.
Pset_DoorCommon.name: Pset_DoorCommon

AcousticRating.definition:
Acoustic rating for this object.
It is giving according to the national building code. It indicates the sound transmission resistance of this object by an index ration (instead of providing full sound absorbtion values).

FireExit.definition:
Indication whether this object is designed to serve as an exit in the case of fire (TRUE) or not (FALSE).
Here it defines an exit door in accordance to the national building code.

FireRating.definition:
Fire rating for this object.
It is given according to the national fire safety classification.

GlazingAreaFraction.definition:
Fraction of the glazing area relative to the total area of the filling element. 
It shall be used, if the glazing area is not given separately for all panels within the filling element.

HandicapAccessible.definition:
Indication that this object is designed to be accessible by the handicapped. 
It is giving according to the requirements of the national building code.

Infiltration.definition: Infiltration flowrate of outside air for the filler object based on the area of the filler object at a pressure level of 50 Pascals. It shall be used, if the length of all joints is unknown.

IsExternal.definition: Indication whether the element is designed for use in the exterior (TRUE) or not (FALSE). If (TRUE) it is an external element and faces the outside of the building.

Reference.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1')

SecurityRating.definition:
Index based rating system indicating security level.
It is giving according to the national building code.

SelfClosing.definition: Indication whether this object is designed to close automatically after use (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

SmokeStop.definition: Indication whether the object is designed to provide a smoke stop (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

ThermalTransmittance.definition:
Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of a material.
It applies to the total door construction.

Pset_DoorWindowGlazingType.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of the glazing component of occurrences of IfcDoor and IfcWindow, used for thermal and lighting calculations.
Pset_DoorWindowGlazingType.name: Pset_DoorWindowGlazingType

BeamRadiationTransmittance.definition: Direct solar radiation transmittance that passes the glazing at normal incidence. It is a value without unit, often referred to as (Tsol).

FillGas.definition: Name of the gas by which the gap between two glass layers is filled. It is given for information purposes only.

GlassColor.definition: Color (tint) selection for this glazing. It is given for information purposes only.

GlassLayers.definition: Number of glass layers within the frame. E.g. "2" for double glazing.

GlassThickness1.definition: Thickness of the first (inner) glass layer.

GlassThickness2.definition: Thickness of the second (intermediate or outer) glass layer.

GlassThickness3.definition: Thickness of the third (outer) glass layer.

IsCoated.definition: Indication whether the glass is coated with a material (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

IsLaminated.definition: Indication whether the glass is layered with other materials (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

IsTempered.definition: Indication whether the glass is tempered (TRUE) or not (FALSE) .

IsWired.definition: Indication whether the glass includes a contained wire mesh to prevent break-in (TRUE) or not (FALSE)

Reflectivity.definition: Fraction of the visible light that is reflected by the glazing at normal incidence. It is a value without unit.

SolarHeatGainTransmittance.definition: Total solar heat transmittance that passes the glazing at normal incidence. It is a value without unit, often referred to as (SHGC):.

ThermalTransmittanceSummer.definition:
Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of a material.
Summer thermal transmittance coefficient of the glazing only, often referred to as (U-value)

ThermalTransmittanceWinter.definition:
Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of a material.
Winter thermal transmittance coefficient of the glazing only, often referred to as (U-value)

Translucency.definition: Fraction of the visible light that passes the glazing at normal incidence. It is a value without unit.

Pset_DoorWindowShadingType.name: Pset_DoorWindowShadingType

ExternalShadingCoefficient.definition: Radiation transmission coefficient of the outside shading device. It is a value without unit.

InsetShadingCoefficient.definition: Radiation transmission coefficient of the shading device inside the glazing, symbol "b-value". It is a value without unit.

InternalShadingCoefficient.definition: Radiation transmission coefficient of the inside shading device, symbol "b-value". It is a value without unit.

Pset_DrainageCatchment.definition:
Definition from IAI: Area of land that drains naturally to a given point (BS6100 modified). Used as a non type driven property set in conjunction with an appropriate instance of IfcSpatialStructureElement that is identified as a catchment using the inherited IfcRoot.Name attribute. Catchments may be nested using IfcRelNests so that subcatchment areas (as component parts of a catchment area) can be identified. A catchment area will be geometrically defined by a closed loop (closed polyline or polyloop)
Note also that the boundary between catchment areas (watershed) is not currently identified.
Pset_DrainageCatchment.name: Pset_DrainageCatchment

AreaDrained.definition: The area measure enclosed within the catchment

Pset_DrainageCulvert.definition: Definition from IAI: Covered channel or large pipe that forms a watercourse below ground level, usually under a road or railway (BS6100). Used as a non type driven property set in conjunction with an instance of IfcSystem that is classified as a culvert.

Pset_DrainageOutfall.definition: Definition from IAI: Structure through which water is discharged into a watercourse or body of water (BS6100). Pset_DrainageOutfall.name: Pset_DrainageOutfall

InvertLevel.definition: The lowest point of the outfall

Pset_DrainageReserve.definition: Definition from IAI: Area exclusively reserved for the routing of drainage services. Pset_DrainageReserve.name: Pset_DrainageReserve

Pset_Draughting.name: Pset_Draughting

In case of several colour information available (line, upper/lower surface, etc.) the sending application shall identify the most significant single colour to be included,

Green.definition: Green component of the RGB colour specification given by an integer of 0..256

Red.definition: Red component of the RGB colour specification given by an integer of 0..255

LayerName.definition: Identifier of the layer name within the sending application.

WorkingPressure.definition: Pressure classification as defined by the authority having jurisdiction (e.g., SMACNA, etc.).

Pset_DuctSilencerPHistory.name: Pset_DuctSilencerPHistory

AirPressureDropCurve.definition: Air pressure drop as a function of air flow rate.

Pset_DuctSilencerTypeCommon.definition:
Definition from IAI: Duct silencer type common attributes.
InsertionLoss and RegeneratedSound attributes deleted in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum: Use IfcSoundProperties instead.
Pset_DuctSilencerTypeCommon.name: Pset_DuctSilencerTypeCommon

AirFlowrateRange.definition: Possible range of airflow that can be delivered.

HasExteriorInsulation.definition: TRUE if the silencer has exterior insulation. FALSE if it does not.

Length.definition: The finished length of the silencer.

WorkingPressureRange.definition: Allowable minimum and maximum  working pressure (relative to ambient pressure).

Pset_ElectricDistributionPointCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: A room or a place or a box where an electrical supply enters and is then further distributed via electrical circuits. A distribution point may be a main distribution point or a sub-main distribution point.
Pset_ElectricDistributionPointCommon.name: Pset_ElectricDistributionPointCommon

CaseMaterial.definition: Material from which the casing surrounding the distribution point is constructed.

IsMain.definition: Identifies if the current instance is a main distribution point or topmost level in an electrical distribution hierarchy (= TRUE) or a sub-main distribution point (= FALSE).

NumberOfOpenings.definition: Maximum number of openings that can fit with the case for normal use. In the openings there must be nipples, so cable may run through.

Pset_ElectricGeneratorTypeCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Defines a particular type of engine that is a machine for converting mechanical energy into electrical energy.
Pset_ElectricGeneratorTypeCommon.name: Pset_ElectricGeneratorTypeCommon

ElectricGeneratorEfficiency.definition: The ratio of output capacity to intake capacity.

MaximumPowerOutput.definition: The maximum output power rating of the engine.

StartCurrentFactor.definition: IEC. Start current factor defines how large the peek starting current will become on the engine. StartCurrentFactor is multiplied to NominalCurrent and we get the start current.

Pset_ElectricHeaterTypeElectricalCableHe.definition: Definition from IAI: An electrical device that outputs heat uniformly along its path.
Pset_ElectricHeaterTypeElectricalCableHe.name: Pset_ElectricHeaterTypeElectricalCableHeater

HeatOutputPerUnitLength.definition: The amount of heat output per unit length of heat emitter.

Pset_ElectricHeaterTypeElectricalMatHeat.definition: Definition from IAI: An electrical device that outputs heat uniformly across its surface area.
Pset_ElectricHeaterTypeElectricalMatHeat.name: Pset_ElectricHeaterTypeElectricalMatHeater

HeatOutputPerUnitArea.definition: The amount of heat output per unit area of heat emitter.

Pset_ElectricHeaterTypeElectricalPointHe.definition: Definition from IAI:  An electrical device that outputs heat as a total quantity from a point or restricted area that can be considered as a point.
Pset_ElectricHeaterTypeElectricalPointHe.name: Pset_ElectricHeaterTypeElectricalPointHeater

HeatOutput.definition: The total amount of heat output by the heat emitter.

Pset_ElectricMotorTypeCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Defines a particular type of engine that is a machine for converting electrical energy into mechanical energy. Note that in cases where a close coupled or monobloc pump or close coupled fan is being driven by the motor, the motor may itself be considered to be directly part of the pump or fan. In this case , motor information may need to be specified directly at the pump or fan and not througfh separate motor/motor connection entities.
Pset_ElectricMotorTypeCommon.name: Pset_ElectricMotorTypeCommon

ElectricMotorEfficiency.definition: The ratio of output capacity to intake capacity.

FrameSize.definition: Designation of the frame size according to the named range of frame sizes designated at the place of use or according to a given standard.

HasPartWinding.definition: Indication of whether the motor is single speed, i.e. has a single winding (= FALSE) or multi-speed i.e.has part winding (= TRUE)

IsGuarded.definition: Indication of whether the motor enclosure is guarded (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE)

LockedRotorCurrent.definition: Input current when a motor armature is energized but not rotating.

MaximumPowerOutput.definition: The maximum output power rating of the engine.

MotorEnclosureType.definition: A list of the available types of motor enclosure from which that required may be selected.

StartCurrentFactor.definition: IEC. Start current factor defines how large the peak starting current will become on the engine. StartCurrentFactor is multiplied to NominalCurrent and to give the start current.

Pset_ElectricalCircuit.definition: Definition from IAI: A circuit supplies electrical devices with voltage and current.
Pset_ElectricalCircuit.name: Pset_ElectricalCircuit

Diversity.definition: A factor that is a means of reducing the cable size on the basis that not all the connected load will be drawing current simultaneously.

MaximumAllowedVoltageDrop.definition: The maximum voltage drop across the circuit that must not be exceeded.

NetImpedance.definition: The maximum earth loop impedance of a circuit (typically stated as the variable Zs)

NumberOfPhases.definition: Number of phases within this circuit.

Pset_ElectricalDeviceCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: A means of collecting together all properties that are commonly used by electrical devices.
Pset_ElectricalDeviceCommon.name: Pset_ElectricalDeviceCommon

ElectricalDeviceNominalPower.definition: The output power rating that is certified for a device.

HasProtectiveEarth.definition: Indicates whether the electrical device has a protective earth connection (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

IP_Code.definition: IEC 529 (1989) Classification of degrees of protection provided by enclosures (IP Code)

InsulationStandardClass.definition: Insulation standard classes provides basic protection information against electric shock. Defines levels of insulation required in terms of constructional requirements (creepage and clearance distances) and electrical requirements (compliance with electric strength tests). Basic insulation is considered to be shorted under single fault conditions. The actual values required depend on the working voltage to which the insulation is subjected, as well as other factors. Also indicates whether the electrical device has a protective earth connection.

NominalCurrent.definition: The maximum allowed current that a device is certified to handle.

NominalFrequencyRange.definition: The upper and lower limits of frequency for which the operation of the device is certified.

NominalVoltage.definition: The range of allowed voltage that a device is certified to handle. The upper bound of this value is the maximum.

NumberOfPoles.definition: The number of logical connections that can be made on an electrical device.

PhaseAngle.definition: The angular difference between two waveforms of the same frequency

PhaseReference.definition: The phase identification used for the device electrical input. This should be the same phase identifier that is used for the conductor segment providing the electrical service to the device. In general, it is recommended that IEC recommendations for phase identification are used (L1, L2 etc.). However, other phase identifiers may be used such as by color (Red, Blue, Yellow) or by number (1, 2, 3) etc.

UsageCurrent.definition: The current that a device is actually handling or is calculated to be handling at a point in time.

Pset_ElementShading.definition: Definition from IAI: Shading device properties associated with an element that represents a shading device, e.g. an IfcBuildingElementProxy or any other building element.
Pset_ElementShading.name: Pset_ElementShading

AverageSolarTransmittance.definition: Overall or average ratio of the solar flux transmitted through a body to that incident upon it.

AverageVisibleTransmittance.definition: Overall or average ratio of the visible spectral flux transmitted through a body to that incident upon it.

Azimuth.definition: Azimuth of the element as derived from the placement of the element shape, by convention: North = 0' and measurement is done clockwise (I.e. east = 90', if unit is grad). The calculation procedure will be specific for each type of element.  In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the azimuth property, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

Inclination.definition: Inclination of the element as derived from the placement of the element shape, by convention: Vertical = 0', horizontal = 90', if unit is grad). The calculation procedure will be specific for each type of element.  In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the azimuth property, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

Reflectance.definition: The ratio of reflected power to incident power.

Roughness.definition: A measure of the vertical deviations of the surface.

ShadingDeviceType.definition: Specifies the type of shading device.

TiltRange.definition: The minimum and maximum angles of possible tilt defined in the plane perpendicular to the extrusion axis (X-Axis of the local placement). The angle shall be measured from the orientation of the Z-Axis in the local placement.

Pset_EnergyConsumptionPHistoryElectricit.definition: Definition from IAI: Measured electrical energy consumption properties.
Pset_EnergyConsumptionPHistoryElectricit.name: Pset_EnergyConsumptionPHistoryElectricity

Pset_EnergyConsumptionPHistoryFuel.definition: Definition from IAI: Measured fuel energy consumption properties.
Pset_EnergyConsumptionPHistoryFuel.name: Pset_EnergyConsumptionPHistoryFuel

Pset_EnergyConsumptionPHistorySteam.definition: Definition from IAI: Measured steam energy consumption properties.
Pset_EnergyConsumptionPHistorySteam.name: Pset_EnergyConsumptionPHistorySteam

Flowrate.definition: The mass flowrate of the steam.

Pset_EnergyConversionDeviceCoil.definition: Definition from IAI: Coil occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcEnergyConversionDevice.
Pset_EnergyConversionDeviceCoil.name: Pset_EnergyConversionDeviceCoil

HasSoundAttentuation.definition: TRUE if the coil has sound attenuation, FALSE if it does not.

Pset_EnergyConversionDeviceSpaceHeaterPa.definition: Definition from IAI: Panel space heater type occurrence attributes.
Pset_EnergyConversionDeviceSpaceHeaterPa.name: Pset_EnergyConversionDeviceSpaceHeaterPanel

Pset_EnergyConversionDeviceSpaceHeaterSe.definition: Definition from IAI: Sectional space heater type occurrence attributes.
Pset_EnergyConversionDeviceSpaceHeaterSe.name: Pset_EnergyConversionDeviceSpaceHeaterSectional

NumberOfSections.definition: Number of vertical sections, measured in the direction of flow.

Pset_EvaporativeCoolerPHistory.definition: Definition from IAI: Evaporative cooler performance history attributes.
Pset_EvaporativeCoolerPHistory.name: Pset_EvaporativeCoolerPHistory

AirPressureDropCurve.definition: Air pressure drop as function of air flow rate.

Effectiveness.definition: Ratio of the change in dry bulb temperature of the (primary) air stream to the difference between the entering dry bulb temperature of the (primary) air and the wet-bulb temperature of the (secondary) air.

EffectivenessTable.definition: Total heat transfer effectiveness curve as a function of the primary air flow rate.

LatentHeatTransferRate.definition: Latent heat transfer rate to primary air flow.

SensibleHeatTransferRate.definition: Sensible heat transfer rate to primary air flow.

TotalHeatTransferRate.definition: Total heat transfer rate to primary air flow.

WaterPressDropCurve.definition: Water pressure drop as function of water flow rate.

Pset_EvaporativeCoolerTypeCommon.definition:
