Pset_EvaporativeCoolerTypeCommon.name: Pset_EvaporativeCoolerTypeCommon

FlowArrangement.definition:
CounterFlow: Air and water flow enter in different directions.
CrossFlow: Air and water flow are perpendicular.
ParallelFlow: Air and water flow enter in same directions.

OperationTemperatureRange.definition: Allowable operation ambient air temperature range.

Pset_EvaporatorPHistory.definition: Definition from IAI: Evaporator performance history attributes.
Pset_EvaporatorPHistory.name: Pset_EvaporatorPHistory

CompressorEvaporatorHeatGain.definition: Heat gain between the evaporator outlet and the compressor inlet.

CompressorEvaporatorPressureDrop.definition: Pressure drop between the evaporator outlet and the compressor inlet.

ExteriorHeatTransferCoefficient.definition: Exterior heat transfer coefficient associated with exterior surface area.

HeatRejectionRate.definition: Sum of the refrigeration effect and the heat equivalent of the power input to the compressor.

InteriorHeatTransferCoefficient.definition: Interior heat transfer coefficient associated with interior surface area.

LogarithmicMeanTemperatureDifference.definition: Logarithmic mean temperature difference between refrigerant and water or air.

RefrigrerantFoulingResistance.definition: Fouling resistance on the refrigerant side.

UAcurves.definition: UV = f (VExterior, VInterior), UV as a function of interior and exterior fluid flow velocity at the entrance.

Pset_EvaporatorTypeCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Evaporator type common attributes.
Pset_EvaporatorTypeCommon.name: Pset_EvaporatorTypeCommon

EvaporatorCoolant.definition: The fluid used for the coolant in the evaporator.

EvaporatorMediumType.definition:
ColdLiquid: Evaporator is using liquid type of fluid to exchange heat with refrigerant.
ColdAir: Evaporator is using air to exchange heat with refrigerant.

ExternalSurfaceArea.definition: External surface area (both primary and secondary area).

NominalHeatTransferArea.definition: Nominal heat transfer surface area associated with nominal overall heat transfer coefficient.

NominalHeatTransferCoefficient.definition: Nominal overall heat transfer coefficient associated with nominal heat transfer area.

RefrigerantClass.definition:
Refrigerant class used by the compressor.
CFC: Chlorofluorocarbons.
HCFC: Hydrochlorofluorocarbons.
HFC: Hydrofluorocarbons.

Pset_FanPHistory.definition:
Definition from IAI: Fan performance history attributes.
Sound attribute deleted in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum: Use IfcSoundProperties instead.
Pset_FanPHistory.name: Pset_FanPHistory

DischargePressureLoss.definition: Fan discharge pressure loss associated with the discharge arrangement.

DischargeVelocity.definition: The speed at which air discharges from the fan through the fan housing discharge opening.

DrivePowerLoss.definition: Fan drive power losses associated with the type of connection between the motor and the fan wheel.

OverallEfficiency.definition: Total efficiency of motor and fan.

WheelTipSpeed.definition: Fan blade tip speed, typically defined as the linear speed of the tip of the fan blade furthest from the shaft.

Pset_FanTypeCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Fan type common attributes.
Pset_FanTypeCommon.name: Pset_FanTypeCommon

CapacityControlType.definition:
InletVane: Control by adjusting inlet vane
VariableSpeedDrive: Control by variable speed drive 
BladePitchAngle: Control by adjusting blade pitch angle
TwoSpeed: Control by switch between high and low speed
DischargeDamper: Control by modulating discharge damper

HousingMaterial.definition: The material used to construct the fan housing.

MotorDriveType.definition:
Motor drive type:
DIRECTDRIVE: Direct drive. 
BELTDRIVE: Belt drive. 
COUPLING: Coupling. 
OTHER: Other type of motor drive. 
NOTKNOWN: Unknown motor drive type.
UNSET: Unspecified motor drive type.

NominalStaticPressure.definition: The static pressure within the air stream that the fan must overcome to insure designed circulation of air

NominalTotalPressure.definition: Nominal total pressure rise across the fan.

OperationTemperatureRange.definition: Allowable operation ambient air temperature range.

OperationalCriteria.definition: Time of operation at maximum operational ambient air temperature.

WheelMaterial.definition: The material used to construct the fan wheel.

Pset_FanTypeSmokeControl.definition: Definition from IAI: Smoke control attributes of a fan participating as part of a smoke control system.
Pset_FanTypeSmokeControl.name: Pset_FanTypeSmokeControl

OperationalCriteria.definition: Time of operation at maximum operational ambient air temperature.

SmokeControlFlowrate.definition: Flowrate of fan while operating as a part of the smoke control system.

Pset_FilterPHistory.definition: Definition from IAI: Filter performance history attributes.
Pset_FilterPHistory.name: Pset_FilterPHistory

CountedEfficiency.definition: Filter efficiency based the particle counts concentration before and after filter against particles with certain size distribution.

ParticleMassHolding.definition: Mass of particle holding in the filter.

WeightedEfficiency.definition: Filter efficiency based the particle weight concentration before and after filter against particles with certain size distribution.

Pset_FilterTypeAirParticleFilter.definition: Definition from IAI: Air particle filter type attributes.
Pset_FilterTypeAirParticleFilter.name: Pset_FilterTypeAirParticleFilter

AirParticleFilterType.definition:
A panel dry type extended surface filter is a dry-type air filter with random fiber mats or blankets in the forms of pockets, V-shaped or radial pleats, and include the following:
CoarseFilter: Filter with a efficiency lower than 30% for atmosphere dust-spot.
CoarseMetalScreen: Filter made of metal screen.
CoarseCellFoams: Filter made of cell foams.
CoarseSpunGlass: Filter made of spun glass.
MediumFilter: Filter with an efficiency between 30-98% for atmosphere dust-spot.
MediumElectretFilter: Filter with fine electret synthetic fibers.
MediumNaturalFiberFilter: Filter with natural fibers.
HEPAFilter: High efficiency particulate air filter.
ULPAFilter: Ultra low penetration air filter.
MembraneFilters: Filter made of membrane for certain pore diameters in flat sheet and pleated form.
A renewable media with a moving curtain viscous filter are random-fiber media coated with viscous substance in roll form or curtain where fresh media is fed across the face of the filter and the dirty media is rewound onto a roll at the bottom or to into a reservoir:
RollForm: Viscous filter used in roll form.
AdhesiveReservoir: Viscous filter used in moving curtain form.
A renewable moving curtain dry media filter is a random-fiber dry media of relatively high porosity used in moving-curtain(roll) filters.
An electrical filter uses electrostatic precipitation to remove and collect particulate contaminants.

CountedEfficiencyCurve.definition: Counted efficiency curve as a function of dust holding weight, efficiency = f (dust holding weight).

NominalCountedEfficiency.definition: Nominal filter efficiency based the particle count concentration before and after the filter against particles with a certain size distribution.

NominalWeightedEfficiency.definition: Nominal filter efficiency based the particle weight concentration before and after the filter against particles with a certain size distribution.

PressureDropCurve.definition: Under certain dust holding weight, DelPressure = f (fluidflowRate)

SeparationType.definition: Air particulate filter media separation type.

WeightedEfficiencyCurve.definition: Weighted efficiency curve as a function of dust holding weight, efficiency = f (dust holding weight).

Pset_FilterTypeCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Filter type common attributes.
Pset_FilterTypeCommon.name: Pset_FilterTypeCommon

FinalResistance.definition: Filter fluid resistance when replacement is required (i.e., Pressure drop at the maximum air flowrate across the filter when the filter needs replacement per ASHRAE Standard 52.1).

FlowRateRange.definition: Possible range of fluid flowrate that can be delivered.

InitialResistance.definition: Initial new filter fluid resistance (i.e., pressure drop at the maximum air flowrate across the filter when the filter is new per ASHRAE Standard 52.1).

NominalFlowrate.definition: Nominal fluid flow rate through the filter.

NominalMediaSurfaceVelocity.definition: Average fluid velocity at the media surface.

NominalParticleGeometricMeanDiameter.definition: Particle geometric mean diameter associated with nominal efficiency.

NominalParticleGeometricStandardDeviatio.definition: Particle geometric standard deviation associated with nominal efficiency.

NominalPressureDrop.definition: Total pressure drop across the filter.

OperationTemperatureRange.definition: Allowable operation ambient fluid temperature range.

Pset_FireRatingProperties.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties related to the combustion of materials for purposes of assessing fire hazard.
Pset_FireRatingProperties.name: Pset_FireRatingProperties

FireResistanceRating.definition: Fire rating identifying the entity's fire resistive value (e.g., 1-hour, 2-hour, etc.) so that its resistance to fire can be compared to that of the surrounding structure.

IsCombustible.definition: Combustibility (YES it is combustible or NO it is not combustible).

Pset_FireSuppressionTerminalTypeBreechin.definition: Definition from IAI: Symmetrical pipe fitting that unites two or more inlets into a single pipe (BS6100 330 114 adapted).
Pset_FireSuppressionTerminalTypeBreechin.name: Pset_FireSuppressionTerminalTypeBreechingInlet

BreechingInletType.definition: Defines the type of breeching inlet.

CouplingType.definition: Defines the type coupling on the inlet of the breeching inlet.

HasCaps.definition: Does the inlet connection have protective caps.

InletDiameter.definition: The inlet diameter of the breeching inlet.

Material.definition: Material from which the object is constructed

OutletDiameter.definition: The outlet diameter of the breeching inlet.

Pset_FireSuppressionTerminalTypeFireHydr.definition:
Definition from IAI: Device, fitted to a pipe, through which a temporary supply of water may be provided (BS6100 330 6107)

For further details on fire hydrants, see www.firehydrant.org
Pset_FireSuppressionTerminalTypeFireHydr.name: Pset_FireSuppressionTerminalTypeFireHydrant

BodyColor.definition:
Color of the body of the hydrant.

Note: Consult local fire regulations for statutory colors that may be required for hydrant bodies in particular circumstances.

CapColor.definition:
Color of the caps of the hydrant.

Note: Consult local fire regulations for statutory colors that may be required for hydrant caps in particular circumstances.

DischargeFlowRate.definition: The volumetric rate of fluid discharge.

FireHydrantType.definition:
Defines the range of hydrant types from which the required type can be selected where:

DryBarrel =	 A hydrant that has isolating valves fitted below ground and that may be used where the possibility of water freezing is a consideration.
WetBarrel =	 A hydrant that has isolating valves fitted above ground and that may be used where there is no possibility of water freezing.

FlowClass.definition: Alphanumeric indication of the flow class of a hydrant (may be used in connection with or instead of the FlowRate property)

HoseConnectionSize.definition: The size of connections to which a hose may be connected (other than that to be linked to a pumping unit).

NumberOfHoseConnections.definition: The number of hose connections on the hydrant (excluding the pumper connection)

PressureRating.definition: Maximum pressure that the hydrant is manufactured to withstand.

PumperConnectionSize.definition: The size of a connection to which a fire hose may be connected that is then linked to a pumping unit.

WaterIsPotable.definition: Indication of whether the water flow from the hydrant is potable (set TRUE) or non potable (set FALSE)

Pset_FireSuppressionTerminalTypeHoseReel.definition:
Definition from IAI: A supporting framework on which a hose may be wound (BS6100 155 8201).

Note that the service provided by the hose (water/foam) is determined by the context of the system onto which the hose reel is connected.
Pset_FireSuppressionTerminalTypeHoseReel.name: Pset_FireSuppressionTerminalTypeHoseReel

ClassOfService.definition: A classification of usage of the hose reel that may be applied.

ClassificationAuthority.definition: The name of the authority that applies the classification of service to the hose reel (e.g. NFPA/FEMA)

HoseLength.definition: Notional length of the hose fitted to the hose reel when fully extended.

HoseNozzleType.definition: Identifies the predefined types of nozzle (in terms of spray pattern) fitted to the end of the hose from which the type required may be set.

HoseReelMountingType.definition: Identifies the predefined types of hose reel mounting from which the type required may be set.

HoseReelType.definition: Identifies the predefined types of hose arrangement from which the type required may be set.

InletConnectionSize.definition: Size of the inlet connection to the hose reel.

Pset_FireSuppressionTerminalTypeSprinkle.definition: Definition from IAI: Device for sprinkling water from a pipe under pressure over an area (BS6100 100 3432)
Pset_FireSuppressionTerminalTypeSprinkle.name: Pset_FireSuppressionTerminalTypeSprinkler

Activation.definition: Identifies the predefined methods of sprinkler activation from which that required may be set.

ActivationTemperature.definition: The temperature at which the object is designed to activate.

BulbLiquidColor.definition: The color of the liquid in the bulb for a bulb activated sprinkler. Note that the liquid color varies according to the activation temperature requirement of the sprinkler head. Note also that this property does not need to be asserted for quick response activated sprinklers.

ConnectionSize.definition: Size of the inlet connection to the sprinkler.

CoverageArea.definition: The area that the sprinkler is designed to protect.

DeflectorMaterial.definition: The material used to construct the deflector plate.

DischargeCoefficient.definition: The coefficient of flow at the sprinkler

DischargeFlowRate.definition: The volumetric rate of fluid discharge.

FrameMaterial.definition: The material used to construct the frame of the sprinkler.

HasDeflector.definition: Indication of whether the sprinkler has a deflector (baffle) fitted to diffuse the discharge on activation (= TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

MaximumWorkingPressure.definition: Maximum pressure that the object is manufactured to withstand.

ResidualFlowingPressure.definition: The residual flowing pressure in the pipeline at which the discharge flow rate is determined.

Response.definition: Identifies the predefined methods of sprinkler response from which that required may be set.

SprinklerType.definition: Identifies the predefined types of sprinkler  from which the type required may be set.

Pset_FlowControllerDamper.definition: Definition from IAI: Damper occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFlowController.
Pset_FlowControllerDamper.name: Pset_FlowControllerDamper

SizingMethod.definition:
Identifies whether the damper is sized nominally or with exact measurements:
NOMINAL: Nominal sizing method. 
EXACT: Exact sizing method.

Pset_FlowControllerFlowMeter.definition: Definition from IAI: Flow meter occurrence common attributes.
Pset_FlowControllerFlowMeter.name: Pset_FlowControllerFlowMeter

Purpose.definition: Enumeration defining the purpose of the flow meter occurrence.

Pset_FlowFittingDuctFitting.definition: Definition from IAI: Duct fitting occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFlowFitting.
Pset_FlowFittingDuctFitting.name: Pset_FlowFittingDuctFitting

AbsoluteRoughnessFactor.definition: The absolute roughness factor of the duct fitting.

Color.definition:
The color of the duct fitting.

Note: This is typically used for any duct fittings with a painted surface which is not otherwise specified as a covering.

HasLiner.definition: TRUE if the fitting has interior duct insulating lining, FALSE if it does not.

Pset_FlowFittingPipeFitting.definition: Definition from IAI: Pipe fitting occurrence attributes attached to an instance of IfcFlowFitting.
Pset_FlowFittingPipeFitting.name: Pset_FlowFittingPipeFitting

Color.definition:
The color of the pipe fitting.

Note: This is typically used only for plastic pipe fittings. However, it may be used for any pipe fittings with a painted surface which is not otherwise specified as a covering.

InteriorRoughnessCoefficient.definition: The interior roughness of the pipe fitting material.

Pset_FlowInstrumentTypePressureGauge.definition: Definition from IAI: A device that reads and displays a pressure value at a point or the pressure difference between two points.
Pset_FlowInstrumentTypePressureGauge.name: Pset_FlowInstrumentTypePressureGauge

DisplaySize.definition: The physical size of the display. For a dial pressure gauge it will be the diameter of the dial.

PressureGaugeType.definition: Identifies the means by which pressure is displayed.

Pset_FlowInstrumentTypeThermometer.definition: Definition from IAI: A device that reads and displays a temperature value at a point.
Pset_FlowInstrumentTypeThermometer.name: Pset_FlowInstrumentTypeThermometer

DisplaySize.definition: The physical size of the display. In the case of a stem thermometer, this will be the length of the stem. For a dial thermometer, it will be the diameter of the dial.

ThermometerType.definition: Identifies the means by which temperature is displayed.

Pset_FlowMeterTypeCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Common attributes of a flow meter type
Pset_FlowMeterTypeCommon.name: Pset_FlowMeterTypeCommon

IsMain.definition: Indicates whether the meter is the main meter on the system. If FALSE, it is a submeter.

ReadOutType.definition: Indication of the form that readout from the meter takes. In the case of a dial read out, this may comprise multiple dials that give a cumulative reading and/or a mechanical odometer.

RemoteReading.definition: Indicates whether the meter has a connection for remote reading through connection of a communication device (set TRUE) or not (set FALSE).

Pset_FlowMeterTypeEnergyMeter.definition: Definition from IAI: Device that measures, indicates and sometimes records, the energy usage in a system.
Pset_FlowMeterTypeEnergyMeter.name: Pset_FlowMeterTypeEnergyMeter

ConnectionSize.definition: Defines the size of inlet and outlet pipe connections to the meter.

Pset_FlowMeterTypeGasMeter.definition: Definition from IAI: Device that measures, indicates and sometimes records, the volume of gas that passes through it without interrupting the flow.
Pset_FlowMeterTypeGasMeter.name: Pset_FlowMeterTypeGasMeter

ConnectionSize.definition: Defines the size of inlet and outlet pipe connections to the meter.

GasType.definition: Defines the types of gas that may be specified.

MaximumFlowRate.definition: Maximum rate of flow which the meter is expected to pass.

MaximumPressureLoss.definition: Pressure loss expected across the meter under conditions of maximum flow.

Pset_FlowMeterTypeOilMeter.definition: Definition from IAI: Device that measures, indicates and sometimes records, the volume of oil that passes through it without interrupting the flow.
Pset_FlowMeterTypeOilMeter.name: Pset_FlowMeterTypeOilMeter

ConnectionSize.definition: Defines the size of inlet and outlet pipe connections to the meter.

MaximumFlowRate.definition: Maximum rate of flow which the meter is expected to pass.

Pset_FlowMeterTypeWaterMeter.definition: Definition from IAI: Device that measures, indicates and sometimes records, the volume of water that passes through it without interrupting the flow.
Pset_FlowMeterTypeWaterMeter.name: Pset_FlowMeterTypeWaterMeter

BackflowPreventerType.definition: Identifies the type of backflow preventer installed to prevent the backflow of contaminated or polluted water from an irrigation/reticulation system to a potable water supply.

ConnectionSize.definition: Defines the size of inlet and outlet pipe connections to the meter.

MaximumFlowRate.definition: Maximum rate of flow which the meter is expected to pass.

MaximumPressureLoss.definition: Pressure loss expected across the meter under conditions of maximum flow.

Type.definition: Defines the allowed values for selection of the flow meter operation type.

Pset_FlowMovingDeviceCompressor.name: Pset_FlowMovingDeviceCompressor

Pset_FlowMovingDeviceFan.name: Pset_FlowMovingDeviceFan

The functional application of the fan:
SUPPLYAIR: Supply air fan. 
RETURNAIR: Return air fan. 
EXHAUSTAIR: Exhaust air fan. 
OTHER: Other type of application not defined above.

CoilPosition.definition:
Defines the relationship between a fan and a coil.

ColorAppearance.definition: In both the DIN and CIE standards, artificial light sources are classified in terms of their color appearance. To the human eye they all appear to be white; the difference can only be detected by direct comparison. Visual performance is not directly affected by differences in color appearance.

ColorRenderingIndex.definition: The CRI indicates how well a light source renders eight standard colors compared to perfect reference lamp with the same color temperature. The CRI scale ranges from 1 to 100, with 100 representing perfect rendering properties.

ColorTemperature.definition: The color temperature of any source of radiation is defined as the temperature (in Kelvin) of a black-body or Planckian radiator whose radiation has the same chromaticity as the source of radiation. Often the values are only approximate color temperatures as the black-body radiator cannot emit radiation of every chromaticity value. The color temperatures of the commonest artificial light sources range from less than 3000K (warm white) to 4000K (intermediate) and over 5000K (daylight).

ContributedLuminousFlux.definition: Luminous flux is a photometric measure of radiant flux, i.e. the volume of light emitted from a light source. Luminous flux is measured either for the interior as a whole or for a part of the interior (partial luminous flux for a solid angle). All other photometric parameters are derivatives of luminous flux. Luminous flux is measured in lumens (lm). The luminous flux is given as a nominal value for each lamp.

LampBallastType.definition:
The type of ballast used to stabilise gas discharge by limiting the current during operation and to deliver the necessary striking voltage for starting. Ballasts are needed to operate Discharge Lamps such as Fluorescent, Compact Fluorescent, High-pressure Mercury, Metal Halide and High-pressure Sodium Lamps. 
Magnetic ballasts are chokes which limit the current passing through a lamp connected in series on the principle of self-induction. The resultant current and power are decisive for the efficient operation of the lamp. A specially designed ballast is required for every type of lamp to comply with lamp rating in terms of Luminous Flux, Color Appearance and service life. The two types of magnetic ballasts for fluorescent lamps are KVG Conventional   (EC-A series) and VVG Low-loss ballasts (EC-B series). Low-loss ballasts have a higher efficiency, which means reduced ballast losses and a lower thermal load. Electronic ballasts are used to run fluorescent lamps at high frequencies (approx. 35 - 40 kHz).

LampCompensationType.definition: Identifies the form of compensation used for power factor correction and radio suppression.

LampMaintenanceFactor.definition: Non recoverable losses of luminous flux of a lamp due to lamp depreciation; i.e. the decreasing of light output of a luminaire due to aging and dirt.

Spectrum.definition: The spectrum of radiation describes its composition with regard to wavelength. Light, for example, as the portion of electromagnetic radiation that is visible to the human eye, is radiation with wavelengths in the range of approx. 380 to 780 nm (1 nm = 10 m). The corresponding range of colours varies from violet to indigo, blue, green, yellow, orange, and red. These colours form a continuous spectrum, in which the various spectral sectors merge into each other.

JUNCTION_TEE_SWEEP: Branch fitting in which the branch is curved through 90 degrees to join a main pipe tangentially. 
JUNCTION_TEE_TWINBEND: Symmetrical pipe fitting in which two short radius bends curve through 90 degree to form a single pipe. 
+I1JUNCTION_TEE_TWINELBOW: Symmetrical pipe fitting in which two elbows curve through 90 degree to form a single pipe. 
JUNCTION_TEE_Y: Branch fitting in the shape of a letter Y. 
OBSTRUCTION_CAP: Device fixed onto the end of a pipe or pipe fitting to close it. 
OBSTRUCTION_PLUG: Device fixed into the end of a pipe or pipe fitting to close it. 
OTHER: Other fitting subtype.
NOTDEFINED: The fitting subtype is not defined.

Pset_PipeSegmentPHistory.definition: Definition from IAI: Pipe segment performance history common attributes.
Pset_PipeSegmentPHistory.name: Pset_PipeSegmentPHistory

LeakageCurve.definition: Leakage per unit length curve versus working pressure.

Pset_PipeSegmentTypeCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Pipe segment type common attributes.
Pset_PipeSegmentTypeCommon.name: Pset_PipeSegmentTypeCommon

EndStyleTreatment.definition:
The end-style treatment of the pipe segment as made available from the manufacturer. If the list contains only one value, then this end-style applies to all ports. For more than one value in the list, the end-style value applies to the port that corresponds to the list index.The following suggested items should be utilized whenever possible for correlation with port enumerations:
FLANGED: Flanged. 
GROOVED: Grooved. 
THREADED: Threaded. 
NONE: No end-style has been applied.
NOTDEFINED: Undefined end-style type.

InnerDiameter.definition: The actual inner diameter of the pipe. Refer to NominalDiameter for comments about interpretation of multiple items in the list.

Material.definition: The pipe fitting material.

NominalDiameter.definition: The nominal diameter of the pipe segment. If the list contains only one value, then this nominal diameter applies to all ports. For more than value in the list, the nominal diameter value applies to the port that corresponds to the list index.

OuterDiameter.definition: The actual outer diameter of the pipe. Refer to NominalDiameter for comments about interpretation of multiple items in the list.

PressureRange.definition: Allowable maximum and minimum working pressure (relative to ambient pressure).

Pset_PipeSegmentTypeGutter.definition: Definition from IAI: Gutter segment type common attributes.
Pset_PipeSegmentTypeGutter.name: Pset_PipeSegmentTypeGutter

FlowRating.definition: Actual flow capacity for the gutter. Value of 0.00 means this value has not been set.

Slope.definition: Angle of the gutter to allow for drainage

Pset_PlateCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcPlate.
Pset_PlateCommon.name: Pset_PlateCommon

AcousticRating.definition:
Acoustic rating for this object.
It is giving according to the national building code. It indicates the sound transmission resistance of this object by an index ration (instead of providing full sound absorbtion values).

FireRating.definition:
Fire rating for this object.
It is given according to the national fire safety classification.

IsExternal.definition: Indication whether the element is designed for use in the exterior (TRUE) or not (FALSE). If (TRUE) it is an external element and faces the outside of the building.

LoadBearing.definition: Indicates whether the object is intended to carry loads (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

Reference.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1')

ThermalTransmittance.definition:
Thermal transmittance coefficient (U-Value) of a material.
It applies to the total door construction.

Pset_PrecastConcreteElementGeneral.definition: Definition from IAI: Production and manufacturing related properties common to different types of precast concrete elements. The Pset can be used by a number of subtypes of IfcBuildingElement. If the precast concrete element is a sandwich wall panel each structural layer or shell represented by an IfcBuildingElementPart may be attached to a separate Pset of this type, if needed. Some of the properties apply only for specific types of precast concrete elements.
Pset_PrecastConcreteElementGeneral.name: Pset_PrecastConcreteElementGeneral

CornerChamfer.definition: The chamfer in the corners of the precast element. The chamfer is presumed to be equal in both directions.

ElementGrossVolume.definition: The gross volume of concrete element. Usually expressed in cubic metre (m3).

ElementNetVolume.definition: The net volume of concrete element. Openings, voids, chamfers, etc. are subtracted from the gross volume. Usually expressed in cubic metre (m3).

ElementWeight.definition: The weight of the concrete element. Usually expressed in kg.

FormStrippingStrength.definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete at form stripping time.

HollowCorePlugging.definition: A descriptive label for how the hollow core ends are treated: they may be left open, closed with a plug, or sealed with cast concrete. Values would be, for example: 'Unplugged', 'Plugged', 'SealedWithConcrete'. This property applies to  hollow core slabs only.

InitialTension.definition: The initial stress of the tendon. This property applies to prestressed concrete elements only.

LiftingStrength.definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete when the concrete element is lifted.

ManufacturingToleranceClass.definition: Classification designation of the manufacturing tolerances according to local standards.

ReleaseStrength.definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete when the tendon stress is released. This property applies to prestressed concrete elements only.

SerialNumber.definition: The manufacturer's serial number for the precast concrete element.

SupportDuringTransportDescription.definition: Textual description of how the concrete element is supported during transportation

SupportDuringTransportDocReference.definition: Reference to an external document defining how the concrete element is supported during transportation

TendonRelaxation.definition: The maximum allowable relaxation of the tendon (usually expressed as %/1000 h).This property applies to prestressed concrete elements only.

TransportationStrength.definition: The minimum required compressive strength of the concrete required for transportation.

TypeDesignator.definition: Type designator for the precast concrete element. The content depends on local standards. For instance in Finland it usually a one-letter acronym, e.g. P=Column, K=reinforced concrete beam,etc.

Pset_ProductRequirements.definition: Definition from IAI: Categorization of the required properties of an entity that are used to determine what the level of the requirement is, to enable its performance/quality to be determined, assessed, or measured, and compared against the requirement, and then to analyze whether the entity is suitable for use within a given context..
Pset_ProductRequirements.name: Pset_ProductRequirements

Category.definition: A reference to a classification of the degree of aggregation or granularity of topic data such as regional, local etc.

Classification.definition: A reference to a classification of the topic

DemandImportanceValue.definition: Importance of the topic relative to the importance of other topics.

DemandThresholdValue.definition: Value of the subject matter above or below which a special significance is attached.

DemandValue.definition: Value of the subject matter as determined using an agreed scale for what is required.

GapValue.definition: Difference determined between the topic demand value and the topic supply evaluation value.

GapValueWeighted.definition: Difference determined between the topic demand value and the topic supply evaluation value, weighted for topic demand importance value.

Name.definition: Subject matter for which a value is to be reported.

SupplyEvaluationValue.definition: Value of the subject matter as determined using an agreed scale for what is provided, or capable of being provided.

Pset_ProjectCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Common properties for a building project.
Pset_ProjectCommon.name: Pset_ProjectCommon

BuildingPermitId.definition: The building permit identifier for the written authorization required by building authorities before construction on a specific project can begin.

ConstructionMode.definition: The type of construction action the project deals with, e.g. new construction, renovation, refurbishment, etc.

GrossAreaPlanned.definition: Total planned area for the project.  Used for programming the project

Pset_ProjectOrderChangeOrder.definition: Definition from IAI: A change order is an instruction to make a change to a product or work being undertake. Note that the change order status is defined in the same way as a work order status since a change order implies a work requirement.
Pset_ProjectOrderChangeOrder.name: Pset_ProjectOrderChangeOrder

ChangeDescription.definition: A general description of the change.

ReasonForChange.definition: A description of the problem for why a change is needed.

Pset_ProjectOrderMaintenanceWorkOrder.definition: Definition from IAI: A MaintenanceWorkOrder is a detailed description of maintenance work that is to be performed. Note that the Scheduled Frequency property of the maintenance work order is used when the order is required as an instance of a scheduled work order.
Pset_ProjectOrderMaintenanceWorkOrder.name: Pset_ProjectOrderMaintenanceWorkOrder

ContractualType.definition: The contractual type of the work.

FaultPriorityType.definition:
Identifies the predefined types of priority that can be assigned from which the type may be set where:

High = action is required urgently.
Medium = action can occur within a reasonable period of time.
Low = action can occur when convenient.

IfNotAccomplished.definition: Comments if the job is not accomplished.

LocationPriorityType.definition:
Identifies the predefined types of priority that can be assigned from which the type may be set where:

High = action is required urgently.
Medium = action can occur within a reasonable period of time.
Low = action can occur when convenient.

MaintenaceType.definition:
Identifies the predefined types of maintenance that can be done from which the type that generates the maintenance work order may be set where:

ConditionBased = generated as a result of the condition of an asset or artefact being less than a determined value.
Corrective = generated as a result of an immediate and urgent need for maintenance action.
PlannedCorrective = generated as a result of immediate corrective action being needed but with sufficient time available for the work order to be included in maintenance planning.
Scheduled = generated as a result of a fixed, periodic maintenance requirement.

ProductDescription.definition: A textual description of the products that require the work.

ScheduledFrequency.definition: The period of time between expected instantiations of a work order that may have been predefined.

ShortJobDescription.definition: Short description of the job requested.

WorkTypeRequested.definition: Work type requested in circumstances where there are categorizations of types of work task. It could be used to identify a remedial task, minor work task, electrical task etc.

Pset_ProjectOrderMoveOrder.definition: Definition from IAI: Defines the requirements for move orders. Note that the move order status is defined in the same way as a work order status since a move order implies a work requirement.
Pset_ProjectOrderMoveOrder.name: Pset_ProjectOrderMoveOrder

MoveDescription.definition: A textual description of the move required.

SpecialInstructions.definition: Special instructions that affect the move.

Pset_ProjectOrderPurchaseOrder.definition: Definition from IAI: Defines the requirements for purchase orders in a project.
Pset_ProjectOrderPurchaseOrder.name: Pset_ProjectOrderPurchaseOrder

IsFOB.definition: Indication of whether contents of the purchase order are delivered 'Free on Board' (= True) or not (= False).

ShipMethod.definition: Method of shipping that will be used for goods or services.

Pset_ProjectOrderWorkOrder.definition: Definition from IAI: Defines the requirements for purchase orders in a project.
Pset_ProjectOrderWorkOrder.name: Pset_ProjectOrderWorkOrder

ContractualType.definition: The contractual type of the work.

IfNotAccomplished.definition: Comments if the job is not accomplished.

ProductDescription.definition: A textual description of the products that require the work.

ShortJobDescription.definition: Short description of the job requested.

WorkTypeRequested.definition: Work type requested in circumstances where there are categorizations of types of work task. It could be used to identify a remedial task, minor work task, electrical task etc.

Pset_ProjectionElementShadingDevicePHist.definition: Definition from IAI: Shading device performance history attributes.
Pset_ProjectionElementShadingDevicePHist.name: Pset_ProjectionElementShadingDevicePHistory

Azimuth.definition: The azimuth of the outward normal for the outward or upward facing surface.

TiltAngle.definition: The angle of tilt defined in the plane perpendicular to the extrusion axis (X-Axis of the local placement). The angle shall be measured from the orientation of the Z-Axis in the local placement.

Pset_PropertyAgreement.definition:
Definition from IAI: A property agreement is an agreement that enables the occupation of a property for a period of time.

The objective is to capture the information within an  agreement that is relevant to a facilities manager. Design and construction information associated with the property is not considered. A property agreement may be applied to an instance of IfcSpatialStructureElement including to compositions defined through the IfcSpatialStructureElement.Element.CompositionEnum.

Note that the associated actors are captured by the IfcOccupant class.
Pset_PropertyAgreement.name: Pset_PropertyAgreement

AgreementType.definition: Identifies the predefined types of property agreement from which the type required may be set.

CommencementDate.definition: Date on which the agreement commences

ConditionCommencement.definition: Condition of property provided on commencement of the agreement e.g. cold shell, warm lit shell, broom clean, turn-key

ConditionTermination.definition: Condition of property required on termination of the agreement e.g. cold shell, warm lit shell, broom clean, turn-key

Duration.definition: The period of time for the lease. Note that values should be given in year/day/month and not in hour/minute/second.

Identifier.definition: The identifier assigned to the agreement for the purposes of tracking.

Options.definition: A statement of the options available in the agreement

PropertyName.definition: Addressing details of the property as stated within the agreement

Restrictions.definition: Restrictions that may be placed by a  competent authority

TerminationDate.definition: Date on which the agreement terminates

Version.definition: The version number of the agreement that is identified

VersionDate.definition: The date on which the version of the agreement became applicable

Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeCircuitBreaker.definition: Definition from IEC 441-14-20: A circuit breaker is a mechanical switching device capable of making, carrying, and breaking currents under normal circuit conditions and also making, carrying for a specified time and breaking, current under specified abnormal circuit conditions such as those of short circuit.
Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeCircuitBreaker.name: Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeCircuitBreaker

Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Common properties for different protective device types.
Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeCommon.name: Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeCommon

CharacteristicTripCurve.definition: A curve giving the time, e.g. prearcing time or operating time, as a function of the protective current under stated conditions of operation.

CutOffCurrent.definition: The maximum instantaneous value of current attained during the breaking operation of a protective device. (IEC 441-17-12)

LimitingTerminalSize.definition: The maximum terminal size capacity of the device.

ProtectiveTagType.definition: The breaking capacity value of the device. Note: This may be expressed as a code or a value depending on standard and/or source.

RatedShortCircuitCurrent.definition: An overcurrent resulting from a fault of negligible impedance between live conductors having a difference in potential under normal operating conditions. (IEC 826-05-08)

StandardUsed.definition: The electrical standard used as a reference when preparing data for the device.

SwitchingDuty.definition: The maximum number of operations for the device at the rated making and breaking capacity.

Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeEarthFailureDev.definition: Definition from IAI: An earth failure device acts to protect people and equipment from the effects of current leakage.
Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeEarthFailureDev.name: Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeEarthFailureDevice

Sensitivity.definition: Current leakage to an unwanted leading path during normal operation (IEC 151-14-49)

Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeFuseDisconnecto.definition: Definition from IAI: A device that will electrically open the circuit after a period of prolonged, abnormal current flow.
Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeFuseDisconnecto.name: Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeFuseDisconnector

FuseDisconnectorType.definition:
A list of the available types of fuse disconnector from which that required may be selected where:

EngineProtectionDevice - A fuse whose characteristic is specifically designed for the protection of a motor or generator.
FuseSwitchDisconnector - A switch disconnector in which a fuse link or a fuse carrier with fuse link forms the moving contact,
HRC - A standard fuse (High Rupturing Capacity)
OverloadProtectionDevice - A device that disconnects the supply when the operating conditions in an electrically undamaged circuit causes an overcurrent,
SemiconductorFuse - A fuse whose characteristic is specifically designed for the protection of sem-conductor devices.
SwitchDisconnectorFuse - A switch disconnector in which one or more poles have a fuse in series in a composite unit.

Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeResidualCurrent.definition: Definition from IAI: A residual current circuit breaker opens, closes or isolates a circuit and has short circuit and overload protection.
Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeResidualCurrent.name: Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeResidualCurrentCircuitBreaker

Sensitivity.definition: Current leakage to an unwanted leading path during normal operation (IEC 151-14-49)

Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeResidualCurrent.definition: Definition from IAI: A residual current switch opens, closes or isolates a circuit and has no short circuit or overload protection.
Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeResidualCurrent.name: Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeResidualCurrentSwitch

Sensitivity.definition: Current leakage to an unwanted leading path during normal operation (IEC 151-14-49)

Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeVaristor.definition: Definition from IAI: A high voltage surge protection device.
Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeVaristor.name: Pset_ProtectiveDeviceTypeVaristor

VaristorType.definition: A list of the available types of varistor  from which that required may be selected.

Pset_PumpPHistory.definition: Definition from IAI: Pump performance history attributes.
Pset_PumpPHistory.name: Pset_PumpPHistory

OverallEfficiency.definition: The pump and motor overall operational efficiency.

Power.definition: The actual power consumption of the pump.

Pset_PumpTypeCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Common attributes of a pump type.
Pset_PumpTypeCommon.name: Pset_PumpTypeCommon

CasingMaterial.definition: Material from which the casing of the pump is constructed

ConnectionSize.definition: The connection size of the to and from the pump

FlowRateRange.definition: Allowable range of volume of fluid being pumped against the resistance specified.

FlowResistanceRange.definition: Allowable range of frictional resistance against which the fluid is being pumped

ImpellerMaterial.definition: Material from which the impeller of the pump is constructed. In the case of a positive displacement pump, the piston acts as the impeller

ImpellerSealMaterial.definition: Material from which the impeller shaft seal of the pump is constructed.

NetPositiveSuctionHead.definition: Minimum liquid pressure at the pump inlet to prevent cavitation.

NominalRotationSpeed.definition: Pump rotational speed under nominal conditions.

TemperatureRange.definition: Allowable operational range of the fluid temperature.

Pset_QuantityTakeOff.definition: Definition from IAI: Description of quantities for work items to be exchanged in addition to the IfcElementQuantity
Pset_QuantityTakeOff.name: Pset_QuantityTakeOff

LayerQuantity.definition: Quantity take-off information specific to a single layer of the element,  if multiple layer information is passed, then the property shall be indexed, e.g. LayerQuantity1, ayerQuantity2, …

LocalContext.definition: Local context information for the take-off quantity, if multiple information items are passed, then the property shall be indexed, e.g. LocalContext1, LocalContext2, …

MaterialLayer.definition: Indication of the material layer (e.g. of a wall or slab) to which the quantity information belongs to)

LocalContext.definition: Local context information for the take-off quantity, if multiple information items are passed, then the property shall be indexed, e.g. LocalContext1, LocalContext2, …

Reference.definition: Reference ID for this specified type of quantity, e.g. linking back to a macro name, etc.

Pset_RailingCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcRailing.
Pset_RailingCommon.name: Pset_RailingCommon

Diameter.definition:
Diameter of the object. It is the diameter of the handrail of the railing.
The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.
Here the diameter of the hand or guardrail within the railing.

Height.definition:
Height of the object. It is the upper hight of the railing above the floor or stair.
The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

IsExternal.definition: Indication whether the element is designed for use in the exterior (TRUE) or not (FALSE). If (TRUE) it is an external element and faces the outside of the building.

Reference.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1')

Pset_RampCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcRamp.
Pset_RampCommon.name: Pset_RampCommon

FireExit.definition:
Indication whether this object is designed to serve as an exit in the case of fire (TRUE) or not (FALSE).
Here it defines an exit ramp in accordance to the national building code.

FireRating.definition:
Fire rating for this object.
It is given according to the national fire safety classification.

HandicapAccessible.definition:
Indication that this object is designed to be accessible by the handicapped. 
Set to (TRUE) if this ramp is rated as handicap accessible  according the local building codes, otherwise (FALSE).

HasNonSkidSurface.definition: Indication whether the surface finish is designed to prevent slippery (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

IsExternal.definition: Indication whether the element is designed for use in the exterior (TRUE) or not (FALSE). If (TRUE) it is an external element and faces the outside of the building.

Reference.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1')

RequiredHeadroom.definition: Required headroom clearance for the passageway according to the applicable building code or additional requirements.

RequiredSlope.definition:
Required sloping angle of the object  - relative to horizontal (0.0 degrees).
Required maximum slope for the passageway according to the applicable building code or additional requirements

Pset_RampFlightCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcRampFlight.
Pset_RampFlightCommon.name: Pset_RampFlightCommon

Headroom.definition:
Actual headroom clearance for the passageway according to the current design. 
The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

Reference.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1')

Slope.definition:
Sloping angle of the object  - relative to horizontal (0.0 degrees). 
Actual maximum slope for the passageway according to the current design.
The shape information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the shape properties, provided in the attached property, the geometric parameters take precedence.

Pset_ReinforcementBarCountOfIndependentF.definition: Definition from IAI: Reinforcement Concrete parameter [ST-2]: The amount number information of reinforcement  bar with the independent footing. The X and Y direction are based on the local coordinate system of building storey. The X and Y direction of the reinforcement bar are parallel to the X and Y axis of the IfcBuildingStorey's local coordinate system, respectively.
Pset_ReinforcementBarCountOfIndependentF.name: Pset_ReinforcementBarCountOfIndependentFooting

Reference.definition: A descriptive label for the general reinforcement type.

XDirectionLowerBarCount.definition: The number of bars with X direction lower bar.

XDirectionUpperBarCount.definition: The number of bars with X direction upper bar.

YDirectionLowerBarCount.definition: The number of bars with Y direction lower bar.

YDirectionUpperBarCount.definition: The number of bars with Y direction upper bar.

Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfBeam.definition: Definition from IAI: The ptich length information of reinforcement  bar with the beam.
Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfBeam.name: Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfBeam

Reference.definition: A descriptive label for the general reinforcement type.

SpacingBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the spacing bar.

StirrupBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the stirrup bar.

Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfColumn.definition: Definition from IAI: The pitch length information of reinforcement  bar with the column. The X and Y direction are based on the local coordinate system of building storey. The X and Y direction of the reinforcement bar are parallel to the X and Y axis of the IfcBuildingStorey's local coordinate system, respectively.
Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfColumn.name: Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfColumn

HoopBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the hoop bar.

Reference.definition: A descriptive label for the general reinforcement type.

ReinforcementBarType.definition: Defines the type of the reinforcement bar.

XDirectionTieHoopBarPitch.definition: The X direction pitch length of the tie hoop.

XDirectionTieHoopCount.definition: The number of bars with X direction tie hoop bars.

YDirectionTieHoopBarPitch.definition: The Y direction pitch length of the tie hoop.

YDirectionTieHoopCount.definition: The number of bars with Y direction tie hoop bars.

Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfContinuousFo.definition: Definition from IAI: Reinforcement Concrete parameter [ST-2]: The pitch length information of reinforcement  bar with the continuous footing.
Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfContinuousFo.name: Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfContinuousFooting

CrossingLowerBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the crossing lower bar.

CrossingUpperBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the crossing upper bar.

Reference.definition: A descriptive label for the general reinforcement type.

Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfSlab.definition: Definition from IAI: The pitch length information of reinforcement  bar with the slab.
Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfSlab.name: Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfSlab

LongInsideCenterLowerBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the long inside center lower bar.

LongInsideCenterTopBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the long inside center top bar.

LongInsideEndLowerBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the long inside end lower bar.

LongInsideEndTopBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the long inside end top bar.

LongOutsideLowerBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the long outside lower bar.

LongOutsideTopBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the long outside top bar.

Reference.definition: A descriptive label for the general reinforcement type.

ShortInsideCenterLowerBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the short inside center lower bar.

ShortInsideCenterTopBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the short inside center top bar.

ShortInsideEndLowerBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the short inside end lower bar.

ShortInsideEndTopBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the short inside end top bar.

ShortOutsideLowerBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the short outside lower bar.

ShortOutsideTopBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the short outside top bar.

Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfWall.definition: Definition from IAI: The pitch length information of reinforcement  bar with the wall.
Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfWall.name: Pset_ReinforcementBarPitchOfWall

BarAllocationType.definition: Defines the type of the reinforcement bar allocation.

HorizontalBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the horizontal bar.

Reference.definition: A descriptive label for the general reinforcement type.

SpacingBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the spacing bar.

VerticalBarPitch.definition: The pitch length of the vertical bar.

Pset_ReinforcingBarBendingsBECCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties expressing the bending information of non-prestressed reinforcing bars. The properties in this Pset are defined according to the local Finnish BEC standard with minor adjustements (only bar bending information is included). The bending shape property definitions apply to both reinforcing bars (IfcReinforcingBar) and reinforcing meshes (IfcReinforcingMesh). It is presumed that a single standard for defining the bar bending is used throughout the project and that this standard is referenced from the IfcProject object through the IfcDocumentReference mechanism.
Pset_ReinforcingBarBendingsBECCommon.name: Pset_ReinforcingBarBendingsBECCommon

BECBarShapeCode.definition: The bending type code for the specific bending shape as defined in the BEC standard. Note: depending on the standardized shape different combinations of following parameters a...e (f...l), TD, u, v, u1, v1, aid_x, and aid_y are used.

BECCuttingLength.definition: Usually calculated from the sum of the partial length parameters with corrections for the bendings.

Pset_ReinforcingBarBendingsBS8666Common.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties expressing the bending information of non-prestressed reinforcing bars. The properties in this Pset are largely defined according to BS8666. It is presumed that a single standard for defining the bar bending is used throughout the project and that this standard is referenced from the IfcProject object through the IfcDocumentReference mechanism.
Pset_ReinforcingBarBendingsBS8666Common.name: Pset_ReinforcingBarBendingsBS8666Common

BS8666ShapeCode.definition: The bending type code for the specific bending shape as defined in the BS8666 standard. Note: depending on the standardized shape different combinations of following parameters A...E and r are used.

BS8666ShapeParameter_r.definition: Bar shape parameter r. Used for bending radius.

Pset_ReinforcingBarBendingsDIN135610Comm.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties expressing the bending information of non-prestressed reinforcing bars. The properties in this Pset are largely defined according to DIN 1356 Teil 10 with some minor omissions: the shape type X2 is not considered since it is better represented by the explicit shape geometry. It is presumed that a single standard for defining the bar bending is used throughout the project and that this standard is referenced from the IfcProject object through the IfcDocumentReference mechanism. Note: This bending standard is presumably to be replaced by the upcoming ISO 3766 standard.
Pset_ReinforcingBarBendingsDIN135610Comm.name: Pset_ReinforcingBarBendingsDIN135610Common

DIN135610ShapeCode.definition: The bending type code for the specific bending shape as defined in the DIN 1356 Teil 10 standard. Note: depending on the standardized shape different combinations of following parameters a...z are used.

DIN135610ShapeParameter_a.definition: Bar shape parameter a. Note: this parameter is also used for parameter a0 (shape code B3)

DIN135610ShapeParameter_b.definition: Bar shape parameter b. Note: this parameter is also used for parameter b0 (shape codes C2 and C3)

DIN135610ShapeParameter_d.definition: Bar shape parameter d. Note: this parameter is also used for parameter d0 (shape code B3)

DIN135610ShapeParameter_e.definition: Bar shape parameter e. Note: this parameter is also used for parameter e0 (shape codes A4 and C3)

Pset_ReinforcingBarBendingsISOCD3766Comm.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties expressing the bending information of non-prestressed reinforcing bars. The properties in this Pset are largely defined according to ISO/CD 3766 with some minor changes in how the hooks are defined (explicit angle measures instead of coded parameters). It is presumed that a single standard for defining the bar bending is used throughout the project and that this standard is referenced from the IfcProject object through the IfcDocumentReference mechanism. Pset_Risk.definition:
Definition from IAI: An indication of exposure to mischance, peril, menace, hazard or loss. 

HISTORY: Extended in IFC2x3

There are various types of risk that may be encountered and there may be several instances of Pset_Risk associated in an instance of an IfcObject (either a physical object, a grouping of physical objects such as an asset or a process).
Specification of this property set incorporates the values of the Incom risk analysis matrix (satisfying AS/NZS 4360) together with additional identified requirements.
Pset_Risk.name: Pset_Risk

AffectsSurroundings.definition:
Indicates wether the risk affects only to the person assigned to that task (FALSE) or if it can also affect to the people in the surroundings (TRUE).

For example, the process of painting would affect all the people in the vicinity of the process

AssessmentOfRisk.definition:
Likelihood of risk event occurring.

Note  that assessment of risk may frequently be associated with the physical location of the object for which the risk is assessed.

NatureOfRisk.definition:
An indication of the generic nature of the risk that might be encountered. 

NOTE: It is anticipated that there will be a local agreement that constrains the values that might be assigned to this property. An example might be 'Fall'  or 'Fall of grille unit' causing injury and damage to person and property

PreventiveMeassures.definition: Identifies preventive measures to be taken to mitigate risk

RiskCause.definition: A value that may be assigned to capture the cause or trigger for the risk. An example might be 'poor fixing'

RiskConsequence.definition: Indicates the level of severity of the consequences that the risk would have in case it happens

RiskOwner.definition: A determination of who is the owner of the risk by reference to principal roles of organizations within a project. Determination of the specific organization should be by reference to instances of IfcActorRole assigned to instances of IfcOrganization (if assigned).

RiskRating.definition: A general rating of the risk that may be determined from a combination of the risk assessment and risk consequence

RiskType.definition: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

SubNatureOfRisk1.definition:
A first subsidiary value that might be assigned to designate a more specific type of risk.

NOTE: Nature of risk may be identified in various ways depending upon the place where risk assessment takes place and according to local agreement. This property set allows for a generic nature of risk and up to two subsidiary natures. An example might be 'causing injury and damage'

SubNatureOfRisk2.definition: A second subsidiary value that might be assigned to designate a more specific type of risk. An example might be 'o person and property'

Pset_SiteCommon.definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSite. Please note that several site attributes are handled directly at the IfcSite instance, the site number (or short name) by IfcSite.Name, the site name (or long name) by IfcSite.LongName, and the description (or comments) by IfcSite.Description. The land title number is also given as an explicit attribute IfcSite.LandTitleNumber. Actual site quantities, like site perimeter, site area and site volume are provided by IfcElementQuantities, and site classification according to national building code by IfcClassificationReference. The global positioning of the site in terms of Northing and Easting and height above sea level datum is given by IfcSite.RefLongitude, IfcSite.RefLatitude, IfcSite.RefElevation and the postal address by IfcSite.SiteAddress.
